enum ContributionStringsProviderAssembler {
    static func assemble(withParams params: Params) -> some ContributionStringsProvider {
        let localeProvider: LocaleProvider = {
            Locale(identifier: Bundle.main.preferredLocalizations.first ?? Locale.current.identifier)

                                                  plansCommonStringsProvider: params.plansCommonStringsProvider)
    }

    struct Params: Sendable {
        let plansCommonStringsProvider: any PlansCommonStringsProvider
    }
}

struct DefaultContributionStringsProvider: ContributionStringsProvider {

         plansCommonStringsProvider: some PlansCommonStringsProvider) {

        self.plansCommonStringsProvider = plansCommonStringsProvider
    }

    var topBar: LocalizedStringResource { localized("Planes_singlecontribution_amount_topbar") }

    var amountQuestion: LocalizedStringResource { localized("Planes_singlecontribution_amount_question") }

    func amountOf(balance: String) -> String {
        let format = String(localized: localized("Planes_singlecontribution_amount_amount"))
        return String(format: format, balance)
    }

        let format = String(localized: localized("Planes_singlecontribution_informative"))
        return String(format: format, maxContribution)
    }

    }

    private let remote: any PlansRemoteDataSource

        self.remote = remote
    }

        try await remote.fetchContributionData(reference: reference)
    }

    func getPromotions() async throws -> PromotionsResponse {
        try await remote.fetchPromotions()

    func simulateContribution(request: ContributionSimulationRequest) async throws -> ContributionSimulationResponse {

struct ContributionTracker: ContributionTracking {

    // MARK: - Constants

    private static let contribution = "aportacion"
    private static let errorContribution = "ko aportacion"
    private static let amount = "seleccionar importe"
    private static let promotion = "aplicar promocion"
    private static let confirmation = "confirmar datos"

    private let logger: any Logs

    init(logger: any Logs) {
        self.logger = logger
    }

    // MARK: - Base Tags

    private func contributionBaseViewTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.viewBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    private func standardBaseViewTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = contributionBaseViewTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2] = Self.contribution
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processName] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    private func contributionBaseEventTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.eventBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2] = Self.contribution
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processName] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    // MARK: - Track helpers

    private func trackView(_ name: String, base: [String: any Sendable], extra: [String: any Sendable]) {
        var tags = base
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackView(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    private func trackEvent(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable]) {
        var tags = contributionBaseEventTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackEvent(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    // MARK: - Views

    func trackAmountView(typology: String) {
        trackView("plans_contribution_amount_view",
                  base: standardBaseViewTags(),
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.amount,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.contribution):\(Self.amount)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                         ])
    }

    func trackPromotionView() {
        trackView("plans_contribution_promotion_view",
                  base: standardBaseViewTags(),
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.promotion,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.contribution):\(Self.promotion)"
                         ])
    }

    func trackConfirmationView(amount: String) {
        trackView("plans_contribution_confirmation_view",
                  base: standardBaseViewTags(),
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.confirmation,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.contribution):\(Self.confirmation)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.formLoanAmount: amount
                         ])
    }

    func trackDocumentView(name: String) {
        trackView("plans_contribution_document_view",
                  base: standardBaseViewTags(),
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: name,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.contribution):\(name)"
                         ])
    }

    func trackErrorContributionView(typology: String) {
        trackView("plans_contribution_error_view",
                  base: contributionBaseViewTags(),
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.errorContribution,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.errorContribution)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                         ])
    }

    // MARK: - Events

    func trackPromotionEvent(label: String) {
        trackEvent("plans_contribution_promotion_click",
                   extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.promotion,
                           AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.contribution):\(Self.promotion)",
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventCategory: Self.promotion,
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + label,
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: label
                          ])
    }
}

LINES: 13 - 57
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': [], 'inherits_or_conforms': [{'type': 'ContributionAmountFieldMapper', 'line': 13, 'evidence': 'ContributionAmountFieldMapper'}], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': [{'target': 'Self.makeLimitsState', 'line': 19, 'evidence': 'Self.makeLimitsState(\n            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,\n            contributionData: contributionData\n        )'}, {'target': 'Self.makeErrorState', 'line': 24, 'evidence': 'Self.makeErrorState(amountError: amountError)'}, {'target': 'PlansUtils.currencySymbol', 'line': 25, 'evidence': 'PlansUtils.currencySymbol("EUR")'}, {'target': 'ContributionAmountFieldView.Model', 'line': 27, 'evidence': 'ContributionAmountFieldView.Model(\n            placeholder: "0,00",\n            currencySymbol: currencySymbol,\n            limitsState: limitsState,\n            errorState: errorState\n        )'}, {'target': 'stringsProvider.limitsRange', 'line': 44, 'evidence': 'stringsProvider.limitsRange(min: min, max: max)'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionAmountFieldMapper: ContributionAmountFieldMapper {
    func mapField(
        stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider,
        contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?,
        amountError: String?
    ) -> ContributionAmountFieldView.Model {
        let limitsState = Self.makeLimitsState(
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            contributionData: contributionData
        )

        let errorState = Self.makeErrorState(amountError: amountError)
        let currencySymbol = PlansUtils.currencySymbol("EUR")

        return ContributionAmountFieldView.Model(
            placeholder: "0,00",
            currencySymbol: currencySymbol,
            limitsState: limitsState,
            errorState: errorState
        )
    }

    private static func makeLimitsState(
        stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider,
        contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?
    ) -> ContributionAmountFieldView.Model.LimitsState {
        guard let min = contributionData?.plan?.minSingleAmount,
              let max = contributionData?.maxSingle else {
            return .hidden
        }

        let text = stringsProvider.limitsRange(min: min, max: max)
        return .visible(text: text)
    }

    private static func makeErrorState(
        amountError: String?
    ) -> ContributionAmountFieldView.Model.ErrorState {
        guard let error = amountError else {
            return .noError
        }

        return .error(text: error)
    }
}

TYPE: struct_declaration
PARENT: None

LINES: 12 - 26
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': [], 'inherits_or_conforms': [{'type': 'ContributionAmountQuestionMapper', 'line': 12, 'evidence': 'ContributionAmountQuestionMapper'}], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': [{'target': 'balance.map', 'line': 19, 'evidence': 'balance.map { stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0) }'}, {'target': 'stringsProvider.amountOf', 'line': 19, 'evidence': 'stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0)'}, {'target': 'ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model', 'line': 21, 'evidence': 'ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model(\n            questionText: questionText,\n            availableBalance: balanceText\n        )'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionAmountQuestionMapper: ContributionAmountQuestionMapper {
    func mapQuestion(
        stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider,
        contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?
    ) -> ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model {
        let questionText = String(localized: stringsProvider.amountQuestion)
        let balance = contributionData?.plan?.linkedAccountBalance
        let balanceText = balance.map { stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0) }

        return ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model(
            questionText: questionText,
            availableBalance: balanceText
        )
    }
}

        stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider,
        contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?
    ) -> ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': [], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': [{'target': 'balance.map', 'line': 19, 'evidence': 'balance.map { stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0) }'}, {'target': 'stringsProvider.amountOf', 'line': 19, 'evidence': 'stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0)'}, {'target': 'ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model', 'line': 21, 'evidence': 'ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model(\n            questionText: questionText,\n            availableBalance: balanceText\n        )'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
func mapQuestion(
        stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider,
        contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?
    ) -> ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model {
        let questionText = String(localized: stringsProvider.amountQuestion)
        let balance = contributionData?.plan?.linkedAccountBalance
        let balanceText = balance.map { stringsProvider.amountOf(balance: $0) }

        return ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model(
            questionText: questionText,
            availableBalance: balanceText
        )
    }

struct DefaultContributionConfirmationContentMapper: ContributionConfirmationContentMapper {
    private let amountHeaderMapper: any ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderMapper
    private let detailsMapper: any ContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper
    private let infoAlertMapper: any ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertMapper
    private let documentsMapper: any ContributionConfirmationDocumentsMapper
    private let footerMapper: any ContributionConfirmationFooterMapper

    init(
        amountHeaderMapper: some ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderMapper,
        detailsMapper: some ContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper,
        infoAlertMapper: some ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertMapper,
        documentsMapper: some ContributionConfirmationDocumentsMapper,
        footerMapper: some ContributionConfirmationFooterMapper
    ) {
        self.amountHeaderMapper = amountHeaderMapper
        self.detailsMapper = detailsMapper
        self.infoAlertMapper = infoAlertMapper
        self.documentsMapper = documentsMapper
        self.footerMapper = footerMapper
    }

    func mapAmountHeader(response: ContributionSimulationResponse) -> ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView.Model {
        amountHeaderMapper.map(response: response)
    }

    func mapDetails(response: ContributionSimulationResponse) -> ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model {
        detailsMapper.map(response: response)
    }

    func mapInfoAlert() -> ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertView.Model {
        infoAlertMapper.map()
    }

    func mapDocuments(documents: [DocumentReadStateModel]) -> ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model {
        documentsMapper.map(documents: documents)
    }

    func mapFooter(
        documents: [DocumentReadStateModel],
        isConfirming: Bool
    ) -> ContributionConfirmationFooterView.Model {
        footerMapper.map(documents: documents, isConfirming: isConfirming)
    }
}

METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': [], 'inherits_or_conforms': [{'type': 'ContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper', 'line': 9, 'evidence': 'ContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper'}], 'dependencies': [{'name': 'stringsProvider', 'type': 'ContributionStringsProvider', 'line': 10, 'evidence': 'private let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider'}, {'name': 'rows', 'type': 'ContributionConfirmationDetailsView', 'line': 17, 'evidence': 'var rows: [ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model.Row] = []'}, {'name': 'stringsProvider', 'type': 'ContributionStringsProvider', 'line': 12, 'evidence': 'stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider'}], 'calls': [{'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 21, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                title: stringsProvider.planLabel,\n                value: planName\n            ))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 29, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                title: stringsProvider.accountLabel,\n                value: account\n            ))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 37, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                title: stringsProvider.giftLabel,\n                value: gift\n            ))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 45, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                title: stringsProvider.dateLabel,\n                value: date\n            ))'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper: ContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper {
    private let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider

    init(stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider) {
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
    }

    func map(response: ContributionSimulationResponse) -> ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model {
        var rows: [ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model.Row] = []

        // Plan name
        if let planName = response.planDescription {
            rows.append(.init(
                title: stringsProvider.planLabel,
                value: planName
            ))
        }

        // Linked account
        if let account = response.linkedAccount {
            rows.append(.init(
                title: stringsProvider.accountLabel,
                value: account
            ))
        }

        // Gift description (only if not empty)
        if let gift = response.singleGiftDescription, !gift.isEmpty {
            rows.append(.init(
                title: stringsProvider.giftLabel,
                value: gift
            ))
        }

        // Collection date
        if let date = response.collectionDate {
            rows.append(.init(
                title: stringsProvider.dateLabel,
                value: date
            ))
        }

        return .init(rows: rows)
    }
}

struct DefaultContributionConfirmationDocumentsMapper: ContributionConfirmationDocumentsMapper {
    private let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider

    init(stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider) {
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
    }

    func map(
        documents: [DocumentReadStateModel]
    ) -> ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model {
        guard !documents.isEmpty else {
            return .empty
        }

        let mappedDocuments = documents.enumerated().map { index, documentState in
            ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model.DocumentsData.Document(
                id: index,
                title: documentState.document.documentDescription ?? stringsProvider.documentLabel(index: index + 1),
                statusText: String(
                    localized: documentState.isRead ? stringsProvider.documentRead : stringsProvider.documentPending
                ),
                statusColor: documentState.isRead ? Color.green : Color.orange,
                iconName: documentState.isRead ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle",
                iconColor: documentState.isRead ? Color.green : Color.secondary,
                base64Data: documentState.document.contentBase64
            )
        }

        return .documents(
            .init(
                headerTitle: stringsProvider.documentsHeader,
                documents: mappedDocuments
            )
        )
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionConfirmationFooterMapper: ContributionConfirmationFooterMapper {
    private let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider

    init(stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider) {
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
    }

    func map(
        documents: [DocumentReadStateModel],
        isConfirming: Bool
    ) -> ContributionConfirmationFooterView.Model {
        if isConfirming {
            return .loading(
                .init(backgroundColor: Color.green.opacity(0.4))
            )
        }

        let canConfirm = documents.isEmpty || documents.allSatisfy(\.isRead)

        if canConfirm {
            return .ready(
                .init(
                    buttonText: String(localized: stringsProvider.confirmButton),
                    backgroundColor: Color.green.opacity(0.4)
                )
            )
        }

        return .disabled(
            .init(
                buttonText: String(localized: stringsProvider.confirmButton),
                backgroundColor: Color(.systemGray5)
            )
        )
    }
}

enum ContributionCoordinatorAssembler {

------------------------------------------------------------
@MainActor
final class DefaultContributionCoordinator: ContributionCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any ContributionAmountFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: any ContributionAmountFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func start(params: ContributionParams) async {
        let viewController: UIViewController = factory.make(
            withParams: .init(
                contributionReference: params.contributionReference
            )
        )
        navigationController.pushViewController(viewController, animated: true)
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
final class DefaultContributionAmountRouter: ContributionAmountRouter {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: any InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func goToConfirmation(simulationResponse: ContributionSimulationResponse) async {
        let stack = navigationController.viewControllers
        let originVC = stack.count >= 2 ? stack[stack.count - 2] : nil
        let coordinator = factory.makeContributionConfirmationCoordinator(
            navigation: navigationController,
            origin: originVC
        )
        await coordinator.start(params: simulationResponse)
    }
}

@MainActor
enum ContributionConfirmationCoordinatorAssembler {
    static func assemble(withParams params: Params) -> some ContributionConfirmationCoordinator {
        let factory = DefaultContributionConfirmationFactory(
            startContributionAuth: params.startContributionAuth,
            getContributionAuth: params.getContributionAuth,
            invalidateCache: params.invalidateCache,
            router: params.router,
            stringsProvider: params.stringsProvider,
            logger: params.logger
        )
        return DefaultContributionConfirmationCoordinator(
            navigationController: params.navigation,
            factory: factory
        )
    }

    struct Params {
        let navigation: UINavigationController
        let startContributionAuth: any StartContributionAuthUseCase
        let getContributionAuth: any GetContributionAuthUseCase
        let invalidateCache: any InvalidateCacheUseCase
        let router: ContributionConfirmationRouter
        let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider
        let logger: any Logs
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
final class DefaultContributionConfirmationRouter: ContributionConfirmationRouter {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private weak let originViewController: UIViewController?
    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         originViewController: UIViewController?,
         factory: any InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.originViewController = originViewController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func showDocument(name: String, base64Data: String) async {
        let coordinator = factory.makePdfViewerCoordinator(
            navigation: navigationController
        )
        await coordinator.start(params: .init(name: name, base64Data: base64Data))
    }

    func finishContribution() async {
        guard let origin = originViewController,
              navigationController.viewControllers.contains(origin) else {
            return
        }
        navigationController.popToViewController(origin, animated: true)
    }
}

func finishContribution() async {
        guard let origin = originViewController,
              navigationController.viewControllers.contains(origin) else {
            return
        }
        navigationController.popToViewController(origin, animated: true)
    }

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionAmountFactory: ContributionAmountFactory {
    typealias Params = ContributionAmountParams

    let contributionDataUseCase: any GetContributionDataUseCase
    let promotionsUseCase: any GetPromotionsUseCase
    let simulateUseCase: any SimulateContributionUseCase
    let router: any ContributionAmountRouter
    let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider
    let logger: any Logs

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> some View {
        let stepIndicatorMapper = DefaultContributionAmountStepIndicatorMapper()
        let questionMapper = DefaultContributionAmountQuestionMapper()
        let fieldMapper = DefaultContributionAmountFieldMapper()
        let infoMapper = DefaultContributionAmountInfoMapper()
        let footerMapper = DefaultContributionAmountFooterMapper()

        let contentMapper = DefaultContributionAmountContentMapper(
            stepIndicatorMapper: stepIndicatorMapper,
            questionMapper: questionMapper,
            fieldMapper: fieldMapper,
            infoMapper: infoMapper,
            footerMapper: footerMapper
        )

        let viewModel = ContributionAmountViewModel(
            contributionReference: params.contributionReference,
            getContributionDataUseCase: contributionDataUseCase,
            getPromotionsUseCase: promotionsUseCase,
            simulateContributionUseCase: simulateUseCase,
            contentMapper: contentMapper,
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            tracker: ContributionTracker(logger: logger)
        )
        return ContributionAmountView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.contributionAmountRouter, router)
    }

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> UIViewController {
        let controller = UIHostingController(rootView: make(withParams: params))
        controller.view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground
        return controller
    }
}

struct ContributionAmountView: View {
    @StateObject private var viewModel: ContributionAmountViewModel
    @Environment(\.contributionAmountRouter) private var router

    @State private var showPromotionSheet: Bool = false

    init(viewModel: ContributionAmountViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch viewModel.state {
            case .initial:
                EmptyView()
            case .loading:
                ProgressView()
            case .error(let msg):
                Text(msg).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            case .success:
                ContributionAmountContentView(
                    stepIndicatorModel: viewModel.stepIndicatorModel,
                    questionModel: viewModel.questionModel,
                    fieldModel: viewModel.fieldModel,
                    infoModel: viewModel.infoModel,
                    footerModel: viewModel.footerModel,
                    amountText: $viewModel.amountText,
                    onAmountChange: { viewModel.validateAmount() },
                    onConfirm: { Task { await viewModel.confirmAmount() } }
                )
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle(Text(viewModel.stringsProvider.topBar))
        .task {
            await viewModel.load()
            showPromotionSheet = viewModel.shouldShowPromotionSheet
        }
        .onReceive(viewModel.$navigation.compactMap { $0 }) { navigation in
            handleNavigation(navigation)
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showPromotionSheet) {
            PromotionSheetView(
                stringsProvider: viewModel.stringsProvider,
                promotionDescription: viewModel.promotionDescription,
                promotionURL: viewModel.promotionURL,
                onAccept: {
                    viewModel.tracker.trackPromotionEvent(
                        label: viewModel.stringsProvider.acceptPromotionButton.spanish
                    )
                    viewModel.selectGift(withPromotion: true)
                    showPromotionSheet = false
                },
                onReject: {
                    viewModel.tracker.trackPromotionEvent(
                        label: viewModel.stringsProvider.rejectPromotionButton.spanish
                    )
                    viewModel.selectGift(withPromotion: false)
                    showPromotionSheet = false
                },
                onClose: {
                    viewModel.selectGift(withPromotion: false)
                    showPromotionSheet = false
                }
            )
            .presentationDetents([.medium, .large])
            .onAppear {
                viewModel.tracker.trackPromotionView()
            }
        }
    }

    private func handleNavigation(_ navigation: ContributionAmountViewModel.Navigation) {
        switch navigation {
        case .goToConfirmation(let response):
            Task {
                await router.goToConfirmation(simulationResponse: response)
            }

        case .showError(let message):
            // TODO: Show error alert
            print("Error: \(message)")
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionAmountContentView: View {
    package let stepIndicatorModel: ContributionAmountStepIndicatorView.Model
    package let questionModel: ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model
    package let fieldModel: ContributionAmountFieldView.Model
    package let infoModel: ContributionAmountInfoView.Model
    package let footerModel: ContributionAmountFooterView.Model

    @Binding package var amountText: String

    package let onAmountChange: () -> Void
    package let onConfirm: () -> Void

    package init(
        stepIndicatorModel: ContributionAmountStepIndicatorView.Model,
        questionModel: ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model,
        fieldModel: ContributionAmountFieldView.Model,
        infoModel: ContributionAmountInfoView.Model,
        footerModel: ContributionAmountFooterView.Model,
        amountText: Binding<String>,
        onAmountChange: @escaping () -> Void,
        onConfirm: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        self.stepIndicatorModel = stepIndicatorModel
        self.questionModel = questionModel
        self.fieldModel = fieldModel
        self.infoModel = infoModel
        self.footerModel = footerModel
        self._amountText = amountText
        self.onAmountChange = onAmountChange
        self.onConfirm = onConfirm
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ContributionAmountStepIndicatorView(model: stepIndicatorModel)

            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: 24) {
                    ContributionAmountQuestionView(model: questionModel)
                    ContributionAmountFieldView(model: fieldModel, amountText: $amountText)
                        .onChange(of: amountText) { _ in
                            onAmountChange()
                        }
                    ContributionAmountInfoView(model: infoModel)
                    Spacer()
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.top, 16)
            }

            ContributionAmountFooterView(model: footerModel) {
                onConfirm()
            }
        }
    }
}

final class ContributionAmountViewModel: ObservableObject {
    enum Navigation {
        case goToConfirmation(response: ContributionSimulationResponse)
        case showError(String)
    }

    private let getContributionDataUseCase: GetContributionDataUseCase
    private let getPromotionsUseCase: GetPromotionsUseCase
    private let simulateContributionUseCase: SimulateContributionUseCase
    private let contributionReference: String
    private let contentMapper: any ContributionAmountContentMapper
    let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider
    let tracker: any ContributionTracking

    @Published var navigation: Navigation?
    @Published var state: ScreenState<Void, String> = .initial
    @Published var amountText: String = ""
    @Published var amountError: String?
    @Published var selectedGiftCode: String = "0"
    @Published var selectedGiftDescription: String = ""

    // MARK: - Published Models (one per section)

    @Published private(set) var stepIndicatorModel: ContributionAmountStepIndicatorView.Model
    @Published private(set) var questionModel: ContributionAmountQuestionView.Model
    @Published private(set) var fieldModel: ContributionAmountFieldView.Model
    @Published private(set) var infoModel: ContributionAmountInfoView.Model
    @Published private(set) var footerModel: ContributionAmountFooterView.Model

    private var contributionData: ContributionDataResponse?
    private var promotions: PromotionsResponse?

    var typology: String {
        switch contributionData?.plan?.planType?.lowercased() {
        case "ppad", "diferida": return stringsProvider.rentaDiferida.spanish
        case "ppa", "asegurada": return stringsProvider.rentaAsegurada.spanish
        case "rf", "fija": return stringsProvider.rentaFija.spanish
        case "ppe", "empresa": return stringsProvider.ppe.spanish
        default: return "-"
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Promotion

    var shouldShowPromotionSheet: Bool {
        guard contributionData?.plan?.hasPromotion == "S",
              let gifts = promotions?.singleContributionGifts,
              !gifts.isEmpty else { return false }
        return true
    }

    var promotionDescription: String {
        getPromotion(withPromo: true)?.giftDescription ?? ""
    }

    var promotionURL: String? {
        promotions?.planPromotion?.url
    }

    init(contributionReference: String,
         getContributionDataUseCase: GetContributionDataUseCase,
         getPromotionsUseCase: GetPromotionsUseCase,
         simulateContributionUseCase: SimulateContributionUseCase,
         contentMapper: some ContributionAmountContentMapper,
         stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider,
         tracker: some ContributionTracking) {
        self.contributionReference = contributionReference
        self.getContributionDataUseCase = getContributionDataUseCase
        self.getPromotionsUseCase = getPromotionsUseCase
        self.simulateContributionUseCase = simulateContributionUseCase
        self.contentMapper = contentMapper
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider

        // Initialize models (will be updated after load)
        self.stepIndicatorModel = contentMapper.mapStepIndicator()
        self.questionModel = contentMapper.mapQuestion(
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            contributionData: nil
        )
        self.fieldModel = contentMapper.mapField(
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            contributionData: nil,
            amountError: nil
        )
        self.infoModel = contentMapper.mapInfo(
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            contributionData: nil
        )
        self.footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            isAmountValid: false
        )
        self.tracker = tracker
    }

    @MainActor func load() async {
        state = .loading
        do {
            contributionData = try await getContributionDataUseCase(reference: contributionReference)

            guard contributionData?.plan?.allowsSingle == "S" else {
                state = .error(model: String(localized: stringsProvider.errorDefaultMsg))
                tracker.trackErrorContributionView(typology: typology)
                return
            }

            if contributionData?.plan?.hasPromotion == "S" {
                promotions = try? await getPromotionsUseCase()
            }

            // Update models with loaded data
            questionModel = contentMapper.mapQuestion(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                                      contributionData: contributionData)
            fieldModel = contentMapper.mapField(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                                contributionData: contributionData, amountError: nil)
            infoModel = contentMapper.mapInfo(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                              contributionData: contributionData)
            footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(stringsProvider: stringsProvider, isAmountValid: false)

            state = .success(model: ())
            tracker.trackAmountView(typology: typology)
        } catch {
            state = .error(model: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    func validateAmount() {
        let error = calculateAmountError()
        amountError = error

        // Update only affected sections
        fieldModel = contentMapper.mapField(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                            contributionData: contributionData,
                                            amountError: error)
        footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                              isAmountValid: isAmountValid)
    }

    var isAmountValid: Bool {
        guard let amount = parsedAmount, amount > 0 else { return false }
        if let min = minAmount, amount < min { return false }
        if let max = maxAmount, amount > max { return false }
        return true
    }

    private func calculateAmountError() -> String? {
        guard !amountText.isEmpty else { return nil }
        guard let amount = parsedAmount, amount > 0 else {
            return "Invalid amount"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        if let min = minAmount, amount < min {
            return "Amount below minimum"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        if let max = maxAmount, amount > max {
            return "Amount above maximum"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        return nil
    }

    @MainActor func confirmAmount() async {
        guard let amount = parsedAmount,
              let otherDataRefVal = contributionData?.otherDataRefVal else { return }

        state = .loading
        do {
            let request = ContributionSimulationRequest(
                singleContributionAmount: String(format: "%.2f", amount),
                contributionType: .single,
                singleGiftCode: selectedGiftCode,
                singleGiftDescription: selectedGiftDescription.isEmpty ? nil : selectedGiftDescription,
                otherDataRefVal: otherDataRefVal
            )
            let response = try await simulateContributionUseCase(request: request)
            state = .success(model: ())
            navigation = .goToConfirmation(response: response)
        } catch {
            state = .success(model: ())
            let errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
            amountError = errorMessage
            fieldModel = contentMapper.mapField(
                stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                contributionData: contributionData,
                amountError: errorMessage
            )
            navigation = .showError(errorMessage)
        }
    }

    func selectGift(withPromotion: Bool) {
        let gift = getPromotion(withPromo: withPromotion)
        selectedGiftCode = gift?.giftCode ?? "0"
        selectedGiftDescription = gift?.giftDescription ?? ""
        amountText = ""
    }

    private func getPromotion(withPromo: Bool) -> PromotionGift? {
        guard let list = promotions?.singleContributionGifts else { return nil }
        return withPromo
            ? list.first(where: { $0.giftCode != "999" })
            : list.first(where: { $0.giftCode == "999" })
    }

    // MARK: - Private
    private var parsedAmount: Double? {
        PlansUtils.stringWithCommaToDouble(amountText)
    }

    private var minAmount: Double? {
        guard let min = contributionData?.plan?.minSingleAmount else { return nil }
        return Double(min)
    }

    private var maxAmount: Double? {
        guard let max = contributionData?.maxSingle else { return nil }
        return Double(max)
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
@MainActor func load() async {
        state = .loading
        do {
            contributionData = try await getContributionDataUseCase(reference: contributionReference)

            guard contributionData?.plan?.allowsSingle == "S" else {
                state = .error(model: String(localized: stringsProvider.errorDefaultMsg))
                tracker.trackErrorContributionView(typology: typology)
                return
            }

            if contributionData?.plan?.hasPromotion == "S" {
                promotions = try? await getPromotionsUseCase()
            }

            // Update models with loaded data
            questionModel = contentMapper.mapQuestion(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                                      contributionData: contributionData)
            fieldModel = contentMapper.mapField(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                                contributionData: contributionData, amountError: nil)
            infoModel = contentMapper.mapInfo(stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                              contributionData: contributionData)
            footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(stringsProvider: stringsProvider, isAmountValid: false)

            state = .success(model: ())
            tracker.trackAmountView(typology: typology)
        } catch {
            state = .error(model: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

private func calculateAmountError() -> String? {
        guard !amountText.isEmpty else { return nil }
        guard let amount = parsedAmount, amount > 0 else {
            return "Invalid amount"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        if let min = minAmount, amount < min {
            return "Amount below minimum"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        if let max = maxAmount, amount > max {
            return "Amount above maximum"  // TODO: Use stringsProvider
        }
        return nil
    }

package struct ContributionAmountFieldView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package enum LimitsState {
            case hidden
            case visible(text: String)
        }

        package enum ErrorState {
            case noError
            case error(text: String)
        }

        package let placeholder: String
        package let currencySymbol: String
        package let limitsState: LimitsState
        package let errorState: ErrorState

        package init(
            placeholder: String,
            currencySymbol: String,
            limitsState: LimitsState,
            errorState: ErrorState
        ) {
            self.placeholder = placeholder
            self.currencySymbol = currencySymbol
            self.limitsState = limitsState
            self.errorState = errorState
        }
    }

    package let model: Model
    @Binding package var amountText: String

    package init(model: Model, amountText: Binding<String>) {
        self.model = model
        self._amountText = amountText
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            HStack {
                Spacer()
                TextField(model.placeholder, text: $amountText)
                    .keyboardType(.decimalPad)
                    .font(.system(size: 32, weight: .medium))
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: true, vertical: false)
                Text(model.currencySymbol)
                    .font(.system(size: 32, weight: .medium))
                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)
                    .stroke(Color(.systemGray3), lineWidth: 1)
            )

            switch model.limitsState {
            case .hidden:
                EmptyView()
            case .visible(let text):
                Text(text)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            switch model.errorState {
            case .noError:
                EmptyView()
            case .error(let text):
                Text(text)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.red)
            }
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionAmountFooterView: View {
    package enum Model {
        case disabled(buttonText: String)
        case enabled(buttonText: String)

        package var isEnabled: Bool {
            switch self {
            case .enabled: return true
            case .disabled: return false
            }
        }

        package var buttonText: String {
            switch self {
            case .enabled(let text), .disabled(let text): return text
            }
        }
    }

    package let model: Model
    package let onConfirm: () -> Void

    package init(model: Model, onConfirm: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.model = model
        self.onConfirm = onConfirm
    }

    package var body: some View {
        Button {
            onConfirm()
        } label: {
            Text(model.buttonText)
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .padding(.vertical, 14)
                .background(model.isEnabled ? Color.green.opacity(0.4) : Color(.systemGray5))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        }
        .disabled(!model.isEnabled)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.bottom, 16)
    }
}

package struct ContributionAmountInfoView: View {
    package enum Model {
        case hidden
        case visible(text: String, imageSystemName: String)
    }

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        switch model {
        case .hidden:
            EmptyView()

        case .visible(let text, let systemName):
            HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: systemName)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Text(text)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(16)
            .background(Color(.systemGray6))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionAmountQuestionView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let questionText: String
        package let availableBalance: String?

        package init(questionText: String, availableBalance: String?) {
            self.questionText = questionText
            self.availableBalance = availableBalance
        }
    }

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(model.questionText)
                .font(.title2.bold())

            if let balance = model.availableBalance {
                Text(balance)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultContributionConfirmationFactory: ContributionConfirmationFactory {
    typealias Params = ContributionConfirmationParams

    let startContributionAuth: any StartContributionAuthUseCase
    let getContributionAuth: any GetContributionAuthUseCase
    let invalidateCache: any InvalidateCacheUseCase
    let router: ContributionConfirmationRouter
    let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider
    let logger: any Logs

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> some View {
        let contentMapper = DefaultContributionConfirmationContentMapper(
            amountHeaderMapper: DefaultContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider),
            detailsMapper: DefaultContributionConfirmationDetailsMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider),
            infoAlertMapper: DefaultContributionConfirmationInfoAlertMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider),
            documentsMapper: DefaultContributionConfirmationDocumentsMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider),
            footerMapper: DefaultContributionConfirmationFooterMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider)
        )

        let viewModel = ContributionConfirmationViewModel(
            response: params.simulationResponse,
            startContributionAuth: startContributionAuth,
            getContributionAuth: getContributionAuth,
            invalidateCache: invalidateCache,
            contentMapper: contentMapper,
            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
            tracker: ContributionTracker(logger: logger)
        )
        return ContributionConfirmationView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.contributionConfirmationRouter, router)
    }

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> UIViewController {
        let controller = UIHostingController(rootView: make(withParams: params))
        controller.view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground
        return controller
    }
}

struct ContributionConfirmationView: View {
    @Environment(\.contributionConfirmationRouter) private var router
    @StateObject private var viewModel: ContributionConfirmationViewModel

    init(viewModel: ContributionConfirmationViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ContributionConfirmationContentView(
            amountHeaderModel: viewModel.amountHeaderModel,
            detailsModel: viewModel.detailsModel,
            infoAlertModel: viewModel.infoAlertModel,
            documentsModel: viewModel.documentsModel,
            footerModel: viewModel.footerModel,
            onDocumentTap: viewModel.click,
            onConfirm: { Task { await viewModel.confirm() } }
        )
        .navigationTitle(Text(viewModel.stringsProvider.topBar))
        .onAppear { viewModel.trackView() }
        .onReceive(viewModel.$navigation.compactMap { $0 }) { navigation in
            handleNavigation(navigation)
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionConfirmationContentView: View {
    package let amountHeaderModel: ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView.Model
    package let detailsModel: ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model
    package let infoAlertModel: ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertView.Model
    package let documentsModel: ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model
    package let footerModel: ContributionConfirmationFooterView.Model
    package let onDocumentTap: (Int) -> Void
    package let onConfirm: () -> Void

    package init(
        amountHeaderModel: ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView.Model,
        detailsModel: ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model,
        infoAlertModel: ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertView.Model,
        documentsModel: ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model,
        footerModel: ContributionConfirmationFooterView.Model,
        onDocumentTap: @escaping (Int) -> Void,
        onConfirm: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        self.amountHeaderModel = amountHeaderModel
        self.detailsModel = detailsModel
        self.infoAlertModel = infoAlertModel
        self.documentsModel = documentsModel
        self.footerModel = footerModel
        self.onDocumentTap = onDocumentTap
        self.onConfirm = onConfirm
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: 0) {
                    ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView(model: amountHeaderModel)
                    ContributionConfirmationDetailsView(model: detailsModel)
                    ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertView(model: infoAlertModel)
                    ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView(
                        model: documentsModel,
                        onDocumentTap: { index, _, _ in onDocumentTap(index) }
                    )
                }
            }

            ContributionConfirmationFooterView(
                model: footerModel,
                onConfirm: onConfirm
            )
        }
    }
}

extension ContributionConfirmationView {
    enum Navigation {
        case showDocument(name: String, base64Data: String)
        case confirmationCompleted
        case showError(String)
    }

    private func handleNavigation(_ navigation: ContributionConfirmationView.Navigation) {
        switch navigation {
        case .confirmationCompleted:
            Task {
                await router.finishContribution()
            }
        case .showDocument(name: let name, base64Data: let base64):
            Task {
                await router.showDocument(name: name, base64Data: base64)
            }
        case .showError(let message):
            // TODO: Show error alert
            print("Error: \(message)")
        }
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
final class ContributionConfirmationViewModel: ObservableObject {

    private let startContributionAuth: any StartContributionAuthUseCase
    private let getContributionAuth: any GetContributionAuthUseCase
    private let invalidateCache: any InvalidateCacheUseCase
    private let contentMapper: any ContributionConfirmationContentMapper
    private let tracker: any ContributionTracking
    private var documents: [DocumentReadStateModel] = []
    private var isConfirming: Bool = false

    let response: ContributionSimulationResponse
    let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider

    // MARK: - Published Models (one per section)

    @Published private(set) var amountHeaderModel: ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView.Model
    @Published private(set) var detailsModel: ContributionConfirmationDetailsView.Model
    @Published private(set) var infoAlertModel: ContributionConfirmationInfoAlertView.Model
    @Published private(set) var documentsModel: ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView.Model
    @Published private(set) var footerModel: ContributionConfirmationFooterView.Model

    // MARK: - Navigation
    @Published var navigation: ContributionConfirmationView.Navigation?

    init(response: ContributionSimulationResponse,
         startContributionAuth: some StartContributionAuthUseCase,
         getContributionAuth: some GetContributionAuthUseCase,
         invalidateCache: some InvalidateCacheUseCase,
         contentMapper: some ContributionConfirmationContentMapper,
         stringsProvider: some ContributionStringsProvider,
         tracker: some ContributionTracking) {

        let documentStates = (response.documents ?? []).map {
            DocumentReadStateModel(document: $0, isRead: false)
        }

        self.response = response
        self.startContributionAuth = startContributionAuth
        self.getContributionAuth = getContributionAuth
        self.invalidateCache = invalidateCache
        self.contentMapper = contentMapper
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
        self.tracker = tracker
        self.documents = documentStates

        // Initialize models (static sections never change)
        self.amountHeaderModel = contentMapper.mapAmountHeader(response: response)
        self.detailsModel = contentMapper.mapDetails(response: response)
        self.infoAlertModel = contentMapper.mapInfoAlert()

        // Initialize dynamic sections
        self.documentsModel = contentMapper.mapDocuments(documents: documentStates)
        self.footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(documents: documentStates, isConfirming: false)
    }

    func trackView() {
        tracker.trackConfirmationView(amount: response.singleContributionAmount)
    }

    @MainActor func click(documentIndex index: Int) {
        guard documents.indices.contains(index) else { return }
        let document = documents[index].document
        let name = document.documentDescription ?? "Document \(index + 1)"

        tracker.trackDocumentView(name: name.tealiumNormalized)

        guard let base64 = document.contentBase64 else { return }
        navigation = .showDocument(name: name, base64Data: base64)
        markDocumentAsRead(index: index)
    }

    private func markDocumentAsRead(index: Int) {
        guard documents.indices.contains(index) else { return }
        documents[index].isRead = true

        documentsModel = contentMapper.mapDocuments(documents: documents)
        footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(
            documents: documents,
            isConfirming: isConfirming
        )
    }

    @MainActor func confirm() async {
        isConfirming = true
        footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(documents: documents, isConfirming: true)

        let request = ContributionAuthStartRequest(
            singleGiftCode: response.singleGiftCode ?? "0",
            periodicGiftCode: response.periodicGiftCode ?? "0",
            contributionType: response.contributionType ?? "U",
            singleAmount: response.singleContributionAmount,
            periodicAmount: response.periodicContributionAmount ?? "",
            revaluationType: response.revaluationType ?? "",
            pdfDocumentsRefVal: response.pdfDocumentsRefVal ?? "",
            conditionsRefVal: response.conditionsRefVal ?? "",
            collectionDate: response.collectionDate ?? "",
            revaluationPercentage: response.revaluationPercentage ?? "",
            collectionDateType: response.collectionDateType ?? "",
            contributionPeriod: response.contributionPeriod ?? "",
            uuid: response.uuid ?? "",
            dataFlowRefVal: response.dataFlowRefVal,
            accountRefVal: response.accountRefVal ?? ""
        )

        do {
            try await startContributionAuth(request: request)
            // TODO: OTP flow — after OTP success, call getResult and finishFlow
            // TODO: getContributionAuth(request: request)
            await invalidateCache()
            navigation = .confirmationCompleted
        } catch {
            isConfirming = false
            footerModel = contentMapper.mapFooter(documents: documents, isConfirming: false)
            navigation = .showError(error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionConfirmationAmountHeaderView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let stepIndicator: String
        package let title: String
        package let subtitle: String
        package let amount: String

        package init(
            stepIndicator: String,
            title: String,
            subtitle: String,
            amount: String
        ) {
            self.stepIndicator = stepIndicator
            self.title = title
            self.subtitle = subtitle
            self.amount = amount
        }
    }

    let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            // Step indicator
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Circle()
                    .fill(Color(.systemGray4))
                    .frame(width: 8, height: 8)

                Text(model.stepIndicator)
                    .font(.caption.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                    .padding(.vertical, 6)
                    .background(Color.green)
                    .clipShape(Capsule())
            }

            Text(model.title)
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)

            Text(model.subtitle)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))

            Text(model.amount)
                .font(.system(size: 36, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(.vertical, 24)
        .background(Color(.darkGray))
    }
}

package struct ContributionConfirmationDetailsView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package struct Row: Identifiable {
            package let id = UUID()
            package let title: LocalizedStringResource
            package let value: String

            package init(title: LocalizedStringResource, value: String) {
                self.title = title
                self.value = value
            }
        }

        package let rows: [Row]

        package init(rows: [Row]) {
            self.rows = rows
        }
    }

    let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(model.rows) { row in
                detailRow(title: row.title, value: row.value)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.top, 16)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func detailRow(title: LocalizedStringResource, value: String) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(value)
                .font(.subheadline.bold())
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(.vertical, 12)

        Divider()
    }
}

package struct ContributionConfirmationDocumentsView: View {
    package enum Model {
        case empty
        case documents(DocumentsData)

        package struct DocumentsData {
            package struct Document: Identifiable {
                package let id: Int
                package let title: String
                package let statusText: String
                package let statusColor: Color
                package let iconName: String
                package let iconColor: Color
                package let base64Data: String?

                package init(
                    id: Int,
                    title: String,
                    statusText: String,
                    statusColor: Color,
                    iconName: String,
                    iconColor: Color,
                    base64Data: String?
                ) {
                    self.id = id
                    self.title = title
                    self.statusText = statusText
                    self.statusColor = statusColor
                    self.iconName = iconName
                    self.iconColor = iconColor
                    self.base64Data = base64Data
                }
            }

            package let headerTitle: LocalizedStringResource
            package let documents: [Document]

            package init(headerTitle: LocalizedStringResource,
                         documents: [Document]) {
                self.headerTitle = headerTitle
                self.documents = documents
            }
        }
    }

    let model: Model
    let onDocumentTap: (Int, String, String) -> Void

    package init(
        model: Model,
        onDocumentTap: @escaping (Int, String, String) -> Void
    ) {
        self.model = model
        self.onDocumentTap = onDocumentTap
    }

    package var body: some View {
        switch model {
        case .empty:
            EmptyView()
        case .documents(let data):
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Text(data.headerTitle)
                    .font(.subheadline.bold())

                ForEach(data.documents) { document in
                    Button {
                        guard let base64 = document.base64Data else {
                            return
                        }
                        onDocumentTap(document.id, document.title, base64)
                    } label: {
                        HStack {
                            Image(systemName: document.iconName)
                                .foregroundStyle(document.iconColor)
                            Text(document.title)
                                .font(.subheadline)
                            Spacer()
                            Text(document.statusText)
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(document.statusColor)
                        }
                        .padding()
                        .background(Color(.systemGray6))
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.top, 24)
        }
    }
}

package struct ContributionConfirmationFooterView: View {
    package enum Model: Equatable {
        case loading(LoadingState)
        case ready(ReadyState)
        case disabled(DisabledState)

        package struct LoadingState: Equatable {
            package let backgroundColor: Color

            package init(backgroundColor: Color) {
                self.backgroundColor = backgroundColor
            }
        }

        package struct ReadyState: Equatable {
            package let buttonText: String
            package let backgroundColor: Color

            package init(buttonText: String, backgroundColor: Color) {
                self.buttonText = buttonText
                self.backgroundColor = backgroundColor
            }
        }

        package struct DisabledState: Equatable {
            package let buttonText: String
            package let backgroundColor: Color

            package init(buttonText: String, backgroundColor: Color) {
                self.buttonText = buttonText
                self.backgroundColor = backgroundColor
            }
        }
    }

    let model: Model
    let onConfirm: () -> Void

    package init(model: Model, onConfirm: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.model = model
        self.onConfirm = onConfirm
    }

    package var body: some View {
        switch model {
        case .loading(let state):
            Button {
                // No action while loading
            } label: {
                ProgressView()
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
            }
            .background(state.backgroundColor)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            .disabled(true)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)

        case .ready(let state):
            Button {
                onConfirm()
            } label: {
                Text(state.buttonText)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
            }
            .background(state.backgroundColor)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            .disabled(false)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)

        case .disabled(let state):
            Button {
                // No action when disabled
            } label: {
                Text(state.buttonText)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
            }
            .background(state.backgroundColor)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            .disabled(true)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
    }
}

.stroke(Color(.systemGray3), lineWidth: 1)'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
struct PromotionSheetView: View {
    let stringsProvider: any ContributionStringsProvider
    let promotionDescription: String
    let promotionURL: String?
    let onAccept: () -> Void
    let onReject: () -> Void
    let onClose: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            header
            ScrollView {
                body(content: descriptionSection)
            }
            footer
        }
        .padding(Spacing.standard)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top) {
            HStack(spacing: Spacing.medium) {
                Image(systemName: "gift")
                    .font(.title2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.tight) {
                    Text(stringsProvider.giftLabel)
                        .font(.headline)
                    Text(stringsProvider.promotionQuestion)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            Spacer()
            Button(action: onClose) {
                Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            }
        }
        .padding(.bottom, Spacing.standard)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func body(content: some View) -> some View {
        content
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var descriptionSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.medium) {
            Text(promotionDescription)
                .font(.body)
            if let url = promotionURL.flatMap(URL.init(string:)) {
                Link(destination: url) {
                    Text(stringsProvider.legalBasesButton)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.blue)
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var footer: some View {
        VStack(spacing: Spacing.medium) {
            Button(action: onAccept) {
                Text(stringsProvider.acceptPromotionButton)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
                    .background(Color.green.opacity(0.4))
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CornerRadius.standard))
            }
            Button(action: onReject) {
                Text(stringsProvider.rejectPromotionButton)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
                    .overlay(
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CornerRadius.standard)
                            .stroke(Color(.systemGray3), lineWidth: 1)
                    )
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, Spacing.medium)
    }
}

final class DefaultEnjoyCoordinator: EnjoyCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any EnjoyFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: any EnjoyFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func start(params: Void) async {
        let viewController: UIViewController = factory.make()
        navigationController.setViewControllers([viewController], animated: false)
    }
}

final class DefaultEnjoyRouter: EnjoyRouter {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: any InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func showPlans() async {
        let plansCoordinator = factory.makePlansOverviewCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
        await plansCoordinator.start()
    }
}

    }

------------------------------------------------------------
struct HiringAdvantagesTracker: HiringAdvantagesTracking {

    // MARK: - Constants

    private static let hiring = "contratacion"
    private static let advantages = "ventajas"

    private let logger: any Logs

    init(logger: any Logs) {
        self.logger = logger
    }

    // MARK: - Base Tags

    private func hiringBaseViewTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.viewBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2] = Self.hiring
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processName] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    private func hiringBaseEventTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.eventBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2] = Self.hiring
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3] = Self.advantages
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.processName] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.eventCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        return tags
    }

    // MARK: - Track helpers

    private func trackView(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags = hiringBaseViewTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackView(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    private func trackEvent(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags = hiringBaseEventTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackEvent(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    // MARK: - Views

    func trackHiringAdvantagesView() {
        trackView("plans_hiring_advantages_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.advantages,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.hiring):\(Self.advantages)"
                         ])
    }

    func trackSheetView() {
        trackView("plans_hiring_advantages_sheetview",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: "nivel de riesgo",
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.hiring):nivel de riesgo"
                         ])
    }

    // MARK: - Events

    func trackClick(_ eventLabel: String) {
        trackEvent("plans_hiring_advantages_click",
                   extra: [
                    AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.hiring):\(Self.advantages)",
                    AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + eventLabel,
                    AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: eventLabel
                   ])
    }
}

final class DefaultHiringAdvantagesCoordinator: HiringAdvantagesCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any HiringAdvantagesFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: some HiringAdvantagesFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

final class DefaultMinisterialOrderCoordinator: MinisterialOrderCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any MinisterialOrderFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: some MinisterialOrderFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func start(params: Void) async {
        let viewController: UIViewController = factory.make()
        viewController.modalPresentationStyle = .pageSheet
        if let sheet = viewController.sheetPresentationController {
            sheet.detents = [.medium(), .large()]
            sheet.prefersGrabberVisible = true
        }
        navigationController.present(viewController, animated: true)
    }
}

struct HiringAdvantagesView: View {
    @Environment(\.hiringAdvantagesRouter) private var router
    @Environment(\.hiringAdvantagesTracker) private var tracker
    let stringsProvider: any HiringAdvantagesStringsProvider

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                    headerSection
                    benefitsSection
                    legalSection
                }
                .padding()
                .padding(.bottom, 16)
            }

            stickyButtons
        }
        .navigationTitle(Text(stringsProvider.title))
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .onAppear {
            tracker.trackHiringAdvantagesView()
        }
    }
}

private extension HiringAdvantagesView {
    // MARK: - Header

    var headerSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(stringsProvider.title)
                .font(.title.bold())
            Text(stringsProvider.subtitle)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Benefits

    var benefitsSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            benefitRow(number: 1, title: stringsProvider.benefit1Title, body: stringsProvider.benefit1Body)
            benefitRow(number: 2, title: stringsProvider.benefit2Title, body: stringsProvider.benefit2Body)
            benefitRow(number: 3, title: stringsProvider.benefit3Title, body: stringsProvider.benefit3Body)
        }
    }

    func benefitRow(number: Int,
                    title: LocalizedStringResource,
                    body: LocalizedStringResource) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 16) {
            Text("\(number)")
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(width: 32, height: 32)
                .background(.blue)
                .clipShape(Circle())

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.headline)
                Text(body)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Legal

    var legalSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(stringsProvider.legal1)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(stringsProvider.legal2)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Sticky Buttons

    var stickyButtons: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Button {
                tracker.trackClick(stringsProvider.continueButton.spanish)
                // TODO: Handle continue action
            } label: {
                Text(stringsProvider.continueButton)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding()
                    .background(.blue)
                    .cornerRadius(12)
            }

            Button {
                tracker.trackClick(stringsProvider.consultMinisterialOrderButton.spanish)
                Task {
                    await router.showMinisterialOrder()
                }
            } label: {
                Text(stringsProvider.consultMinisterialOrderButton)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.blue)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding()
                    .background(Color(.systemGray6))
                    .cornerRadius(12)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(Color(.systemBackground))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.1), radius: 8, y: -4)
    }
}
