struct DefaultMinisterialOrderFactory: MinisterialOrderFactory {
    private let tracking: any HiringAdvantagesTracking

    init(tracking: some HiringAdvantagesTracking) {
        self.tracking = tracking
    }

    func make() -> some View {

            withParams: .init()

        return MinisterialOrderView(stringsProvider: stringsProvider)
            .environment(\.hiringAdvantagesTracker, tracking)
    }

    func make() -> UIViewController {
        let controller = UIHostingController(rootView: make())
        return controller
    }

struct MinisterialOrderView: View {
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(\.hiringAdvantagesTracker) private var tracker
    let stringsProvider: any MinisterialOrderStringsProvider

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Text(stringsProvider.title)
                        .font(.title2.bold())
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                    Spacer(minLength: 10)

                    Text(stringsProvider.subtitle)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                    Spacer(minLength: 4)

                    Text(stringsProvider.body1)
                        .font(.body)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                    riskImageView

                    Text(stringsProvider.riskLevel)
                        .font(.body)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                    Spacer(minLength: 16)

                    lockTextRow(text: stringsProvider.key1)

                    Spacer(minLength: 8)

                    lockTextRow(text: stringsProvider.key2)
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 20)
                .padding(.bottom, 40)
            }.toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
                    Button {
                        dismiss()
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    }
                    // Accessibility improvement
                    .accessibilityLabel("Close settings screen")
                }
            }
            .onAppear {
                tracker.trackSheetView()
            }
        }
    }
}

private extension MinisterialOrderView {
    var closeButton: some View {
        Button {
            dismiss()
        } label: {
            Image(systemName: "xmark")
                .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .frame(width: 32, height: 32)
                .background(Color(.systemGray5))
                .clipShape(Circle())
        }
        .padding(.top, 16)
        .padding(.trailing, 16)
    }

    var riskImageView: some View {
        VStack {
            // Placeholder for risk image
            // Original uses: risk_6_es, risk_6_ca, risk_6_en based on language
            Image(systemName: "chart.bar.fill")
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(height: 110)
                .foregroundStyle(.blue)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 16)
    }

    func lockTextRow(text: LocalizedStringResource) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 8) {
            HStack(spacing: 0) {
                lockIcon
                lockIcon
            }

            Text(text)
                .font(.caption)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

            Spacer()
        }
    }

    var lockIcon: some View {
        // Placeholder for lock_gray image
        Image(systemName: "lock.fill")
            .resizable()
            .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
            .foregroundStyle(.gray)
    }
}

enum PdfViewerStringsProviderAssembler {
    static func assemble(withParams params: Params) -> some PdfViewerStringsProvider {
        let localeProvider: LocaleProvider = {
            Locale(identifier: Bundle.main.preferredLocalizations.first ?? Locale.current.identifier)
        }
        return DefaultPdfViewerStringsProvider(localeProvider: localeProvider,
                                               plansCommonStringsProvider: params.plansCommonStringsProvider)
    }

    struct Params: Sendable {
        let plansCommonStringsProvider: any PlansCommonStringsProvider
    }
}

enum PdfViewerError: Error, Sendable, Equatable, LocalizedError {
    case decoding

    var errorDescription: String? {
        guard let provider = PdfViewerStringsContext.provider else {
            assertionFailure("PdfViewerStringsContext not set")
            return nil
        }

        switch self {
        case .decoding:
            return String(localized: provider.decodeError)
        }
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
final class DefaultPdfViewerCoordinator: PdfViewerCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any PDFViewerFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: some PDFViewerFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func start(params: PdfViewerParams) async {
        let viewController: UIViewController = factory.make(
            withParams: .init(name: params.name,
                              base64Data: params.base64Data)
        )
        let nav = UINavigationController(rootViewController: viewController)
        nav.modalPresentationStyle = .pageSheet
        navigationController.present(nav, animated: true)
    }
}

struct PDFViewerView: View {
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    @StateObject var viewModel: PDFViewerViewModel

    init(viewModel: PDFViewerViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch viewModel.state {
            case .initial:
                EmptyView()
            case .loading:
                ProgressView()
            case .success(let document):
                PDFKitView(document: document)
            case .error(let msg):
                VStack(spacing: 16) {
                    Image(systemName: "doc.text.fill")
                        .font(.largeTitle)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Text(msg)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle(viewModel.title)
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarLeading) {
                Button {
                    dismiss()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                }
            }
            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
                Button {
                    viewModel.share()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "square.and.arrow.up")
                }
            }
        }
        .loading(show: $viewModel.loading)
        .sheet(isPresented: $viewModel.showShareSheet) {
            ShareSheet(items: [viewModel.fileURL])
        }.task {
            await viewModel.decodeDocument()
        }
    }
}

struct LoadingModifier: ViewModifier {
    @Binding var show: Bool

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            content

            if show {
                ZStack {
                    Color.black.opacity(0.3)
                        .ignoresSafeArea()

                    ProgressView()
                        .progressViewStyle(CircularProgressViewStyle())
                        .scaleEffect(1.5)
                        .padding(20)
                        .background(.ultraThinMaterial)
                        .cornerRadius(12)
                }
                .transition(.opacity)
                .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: show)
            }
        }
    }
}

final class PDFViewerViewModel: ObservableObject {
    private let document: PDFViewerDocument

    var title: String { document.name }
    var fileURL: URL {
        let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
        return tempDir.appendingPathComponent("\(document.name).pdf")
    }
    let pdfViewerStringsProvider: any PdfViewerStringsProvider

    @Published var state: ScreenState<PDFDocument, String> = .initial
    @Published var showShareSheet: Bool = false
    @Published var loading: Bool = false

    init(document: PDFViewerDocument,
         pdfViewerStringsProvider: some PdfViewerStringsProvider) {
        self.document = document
        self.pdfViewerStringsProvider = pdfViewerStringsProvider
    }

    nonisolated private static func buildDocument(from base64Data: String) async throws -> PDFDocument {
        guard let data = Data(base64Encoded: base64Data),
              let document = PDFDocument(data: data) else {
            throw PdfViewerError.decoding
        }
        return document
    }

    @MainActor func share() {
        loading = true
        Task {
            guard case let .success(pdfDocument) = state else {
                return
            }
            showShareSheet = pdfDocument.write(to: fileURL)
            loading = false
        }
    }

    @MainActor func decodeDocument() async {
        state = .loading

        await Task { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }

            do {
                let document = try await Self.buildDocument(from: document.rawData)
                state = .success(model: document)

SIGNATURE: nonisolated private static func buildDocument(from base64Data: String) async throws -> PDFDocument
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import SwiftUI', 'import Utils', 'import PDFKit'], 'modifiers': ['nonisolated', 'private', 'static'], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': []}
------------------------------------------------------------
nonisolated private static func buildDocument(from base64Data: String) async throws -> PDFDocument {
        guard let data = Data(base64Encoded: base64Data),
              let document = PDFDocument(data: data) else {
            throw PdfViewerError.decoding
        }
        return document
    }

SIGNATURE: @MainActor func decodeDocument() async
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import SwiftUI', 'import Utils', 'import PDFKit'], 'modifiers': ['@MainActor'], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': [{'target': 'Self.buildDocument', 'line': 58, 'evidence': 'Self.buildDocument(from: document.rawData)'}, {'target': 'PdfViewerStringsContext.$provider.withValue', 'line': 61, 'evidence': 'PdfViewerStringsContext.$provider.withValue(pdfViewerStringsProvider) {\n                    state = .error(model: error.localizedDescription)\n                }'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
@MainActor func decodeDocument() async {
        state = .loading

        await Task { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }

            do {
                let document = try await Self.buildDocument(from: document.rawData)
                state = .success(model: document)
            } catch {
                PdfViewerStringsContext.$provider.withValue(pdfViewerStringsProvider) {
                    state = .error(model: error.localizedDescription)
                }
            }
        }.value
    }

    // Tabs
    var contributionsTab: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var informationTab: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Personal contributions
    var availableBalance: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var annualReturn: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var singleContribution: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Company contributions
    var companyContributionsTitle: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var companyContributionAmount: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var taxDeduction: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var yourContributionsTitle: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Information tab
    var planTypeSection: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var planName: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var planType: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var contractDate: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var contractNumber: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var linkedAccount: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Other
    var legal: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var contribute: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Plan types
    var rentaDiferida: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var rentaAsegurada: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var rentaFija: LocalizedStringResource { get }
    var ppe: LocalizedStringResource { get }

    // Formatted
    func lastUpdated(date: String) -> String
    func periodicFrequency(_ frequency: String) -> String
}

enum PlanDetailStringsProviderAssembler {
    static func assemble(withParams params: Params) -> some PlanDetailStringsProvider {
        let localeProvider: LocaleProvider = {
            Locale(identifier: Bundle.main.preferredLocalizations.first ?? Locale.current.identifier)
        }
        return DefaultPlanDetailStringsProvider(localeProvider: localeProvider,
                                                plansCommonStringsProvider: params.plansCommonStringsProvider)
    }

    struct Params: Sendable {
        let plansCommonStringsProvider: any PlansCommonStringsProvider
    }
}

struct DefaultPlanDetailStringsProvider: PlanDetailStringsProvider {
    private let localized: PlansLocalizer
    private let plansCommonStringsProvider: any PlansCommonStringsProvider

    init(localeProvider: @escaping LocaleProvider,
         plansCommonStringsProvider: some PlansCommonStringsProvider) {
        self.localized = PlansLocalizer(table: "Plans", bundle: #bundle, localeProvider: localeProvider)
        self.plansCommonStringsProvider = plansCommonStringsProvider
    }

    var contributionsTab: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_aportaciones") }
    var informationTab: LocalizedStringResource { localized("commons_informacion") }

    var availableBalance: LocalizedStringResource { localized("common_saldo_disponible_text") }
    var annualReturn: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts") }
    var singleContribution: LocalizedStringResource {
        localized("PPENSIONES_PersonalPlansDetail_withoutperiodicity_TotalAñoActual")
    }

    var companyContributionsTitle: LocalizedStringResource {
        localized("PPENSIONES_EmpresaPlansDetail_payments_data_emp_title")
    }
    var companyContributionAmount: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_EmpresaPlansDetail_payments_emp_1") }
    var taxDeduction: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_EmpresaPlansDetail_payments_reduc_Fis") }
    var yourContributionsTitle: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPE_EmpresaPlansDetail_yours") }

    var planTypeSection: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts_tipoplan") }
    var planName: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_name") }
    var planType: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts_type_plan") }
    var contractDate: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_contratacion") }
    var contractNumber: LocalizedStringResource { localized("commons_numero_contrato") }
    var linkedAccount: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_cuenta_vinculada") }

    var legal: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts_legal") }
    var contribute: LocalizedStringResource { localized("PPENSIONES_PersonalPlansDetail_payments_AportarDinero") }

    var rentaDiferida: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_renta_diferida") }
    var rentaAsegurada: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_renta_asegurada") }
    var rentaFija: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_renta_fija") }
    var ppe: LocalizedStringResource { localized("pdp_ppe") }

    func lastUpdated(date: String) -> String {
        let format = String(localized: localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts_updated_variable"))
        return String(format: format, date)
    }

    func periodicFrequency(_ frequency: String) -> String {
        let format = String(localized: localized("PPENSIONES_Distributor_WithProducts_periodica"))
        return String(format: format, frequency)
    }

    var errorDefaultMsg: LocalizedStringResource { plansCommonStringsProvider.errorDefaultMsg }
    var error: LocalizedStringResource { plansCommonStringsProvider.error }
    var okey: LocalizedStringResource { plansCommonStringsProvider.okey }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultPlanDetailRepository: PlanDetailRepository {
    private let remote: any PlansRemoteDataSource

    init(remote: any PlansRemoteDataSource) {
        self.remote = remote
    }

    func getPlanDetail(reference: String, type: Plan.PlanType) async throws -> PlanDetailResult {
        switch type {
        case .personal:
            let response = try await remote.fetchPersonalPlanDetail(reference: reference)
            return .personal(response)
        case .company:
            let response = try await remote.fetchCompanyPlanDetail(reference: reference)
            return .company(response)
        }
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct PlanDetailTracker: PlanDetailTracking {

    // MARK: - Constants

    private static let detail = "ver detalle"
    private static let contribution = "aportacion"
    private static let information = "informacion"
    private static let contributionEventCategory = "aportar dinero"

    private let logger: any Logs

    init(logger: any Logs) {
        self.logger = logger
    }

    // MARK: - Base Tags

    private func detailBaseViewTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.viewBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    private func detailBaseEventTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.eventBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2] = Self.detail
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.eventCategory] = Self.contributionEventCategory
        return tags
    }

    // MARK: - Track helpers

    private func trackView(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags = detailBaseViewTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackView(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    private func trackEvent(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags = detailBaseEventTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackEvent(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    // MARK: - Views

    func trackContributionView(typology: String) {
        trackView("plans_detail_contribution_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.detail,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.contribution,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.detail):\(Self.contribution)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                         ])
    }

    func trackInformationView(typology: String) {
        trackView("plans_detail_information_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.detail,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.information,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.detail):\(Self.information)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                         ])
    }

    // MARK: - Events

    func trackContributionClick(typology: String, label: String) {
        trackEvent("plans_detail_contribution_click",
                   extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.contribution,
                           AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.detail):\(Self.contribution)",
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + label,
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: label,
                           AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                          ])
    }

    func trackInformationClick(typology: String, label: String) {
        trackEvent("plans_detail_information_click",
                   extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory3: Self.information,
                           AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.detail):\(Self.information)",
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + label,
                           AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: label,
                           AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                          ])
    }
}

struct DefaultPlanDetailMapper: PlanDetailMapper {
    private let stringsProvider: any PlanDetailStringsProvider

    init(stringsProvider: some PlanDetailStringsProvider) {
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
    }

    func map(plan: Plan, result: PlanDetailResult) -> PlanDetailContentView.Model {
        return switch result {
        case .personal(let response): map(plan: plan, response: response)
        case .company(let response): map(plan: plan, response: response)
        }
    }

    private func map(plan: Plan, participantPlanDetail: ParticipantPlanDetail?) -> PlanDetailInformation.Model {
        let planTypeName = planTypeName(participantPlanDetail?.planType ?? "Personal")

        var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = [
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planName,
                  value: plan.name),
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planType, value: planTypeName)
        ]

        if let date = participantPlanDetail?.contractDate {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.contractDate,
                              value: date))
        }

        if let contractNumber = participantPlanDetail?.contractNumber {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.contractNumber,
                              value: contractNumber))
        }

        if let account = participantPlanDetail?.accountIBAN {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.linkedAccount,
                              value: account))
        }

        return PlanDetailInformation.Model(
            header: .init(title: stringsProvider.planTypeSection),
            rows: rows
        )
    }

    private func map(plan: Plan, response: PersonalPlanDetailResponse) -> PlanDetailContentView.Model {
        var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = [
            {
                guard let balance = response.participantPlanDetail?.planBalance else {
                    return nil
                }
                return .init(title: stringsProvider.availableBalance,
                             value: balance)
            }(),
            {
                guard let annualReturn = response.participantPlanDetail?.annualReturn else {
                    return nil
                }
                return .init(title: stringsProvider.annualReturn,
                             value: annualReturn)
            }()
        ].compactMap({ $0 })

        rows.append(contentsOf: (
            response.participantPlanDetail?.periodicContributions?.map { contribution -> PlanDetailRow.Model? in
                guard let amount = contribution.amount else { return nil }
                guard let frequency = contribution.frequency else { return nil }
                return .init(title: LocalizedStringResource(stringLiteral: amount),
                             value: stringsProvider.periodicFrequency(frequency))
            } ?? []
        ).compactMap({ $0 }))

        rows.append(contentsOf: [
            {
                guard let singleContribution = response.participantPlanDetail?.singleContribution else {
                    return nil
                }
                return .init(title: stringsProvider.singleContribution,
                             value: singleContribution)
            }()
        ].compactMap({ $0 }))

        return .init(header: map(plan: plan),
                     information: map(plan: plan, participantPlanDetail: response.participantPlanDetail),
                     contribution: .personal(
                        model: .init(rows: rows)
                     ),
                     contributionsTab: stringsProvider.contributionsTab,
                     informationTab: stringsProvider.informationTab,
                     legal: stringsProvider.legal,
                     contribute: stringsProvider.contribute,
                     isContributionEnabled: response.isContributionEnabled,
                     contributionReference: response.detailReference)
    }

    private func map(plan: Plan) -> PlanDetailHeader.Model {
        .init(balance: PlansUtils.amountString(amount: plan.balance, currency: "EUR"),
              capitalGain: PlansUtils.signedAmount(amount: plan.capitalGain, currency: "EUR"),
              capitalGainColor: plan.capitalGain > 0 ? .primary : .red,
              profitability: String(format: "%.2f%%", plan.profitability),
              lastValuationDate: stringsProvider.lastUpdated(date: plan.lastValuationDate))
    }

    private func map(plan: Plan, employeePlanDetail: EmployeePlanDetail?) -> PlanDetailInformation.Model {
        let planTypeName = planTypeName(employeePlanDetail?.planType ?? String(localized: stringsProvider.ppe))

        var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = [
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planName,
                  value: plan.name),
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planType, value: planTypeName)
        ]

        if let date = employeePlanDetail?.startDate {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.contractDate,
                              value: date))
        }

        if let account = employeePlanDetail?.linkedAccount {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.linkedAccount,
                              value: account))
        }

        return PlanDetailInformation.Model(
            header: .init(title: stringsProvider.planTypeSection),
            rows: rows
        )
    }

    private func map(plan: Plan, response: CompanyPlanDetailResponse) -> PlanDetailContentView.Model {
        var items = [CompanyContributionsSection.Model.Item]()

        if let promoter = response.employeePlanDetail?.promoter {
            var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()
            if let amount = promoter.currentYearContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,
                    value: amount
                ))
            }
            if let taxDeduction = promoter.taxDeductionContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,
                    value: taxDeduction
                ))
            }
            items.append(
                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.companyContributionsTitle),
                      rows: rows)
            )
        }

        if let participant = response.employeePlanDetail?.participant {
            var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()
            if let amount = participant.voluntaryCurrentYearContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,
                    value: amount
                ))
            }
            if let taxDeduction = participant.taxDeductionContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,
                    value: taxDeduction
                ))
            }
            items.append(
                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.yourContributionsTitle),
                      rows: rows)
            )
        }

        return .init(header: map(plan: plan),
                     information: map(plan: plan, employeePlanDetail: response.employeePlanDetail),
                     contribution: .company(
                        model: .init(items: items)
                     ),
                     contributionsTab: stringsProvider.contributionsTab,
                     informationTab: stringsProvider.informationTab,
                     legal: stringsProvider.legal,
                     contribute: stringsProvider.contribute,
                     isContributionEnabled: false,
                     contributionReference: response.detailReference)
    }

    private func planTypeName(_ type: String) -> String {
        return switch type.lowercased() {
        case "ppad", "diferida": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaDiferida)
        case "ppa", "asegurada": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaAsegurada)
        case "rf", "fija": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaFija)
        case "ppe", "empresa": String(localized: stringsProvider.ppe)
        default: type
        }
    }
}

                             value: balance)
            }(),

                guard let annualReturn = response.participantPlanDetail?.annualReturn else {

                             value: annualReturn)
            }()

            response.participantPlanDetail?.periodicContributions?.map { contribution -> PlanDetailRow.Model? in
                guard let amount = contribution.amount else { return nil }

                return .init(title: LocalizedStringResource(stringLiteral: amount),
                             value: stringsProvider.periodicFrequency(frequency))
            } ?? []
        ).compactMap({ $0 }))

        rows.append(contentsOf: [
            {
                guard let singleContribution = response.participantPlanDetail?.singleContribution else {
                    return nil
                }
                return .init(title: stringsProvider.singleContribution,
                             value: singleContribution)
            }()
        ].compactMap({ $0 }))

                     information: map(plan: plan, participantPlanDetail: response.participantPlanDetail),

                     contributionReference: response.detailReference)

METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': ['private'], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [{'name': 'rows', 'type': 'PlanDetailRow', 'line': 114, 'evidence': 'var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = [\n            .init(title: stringsProvider.planName,\n                  value: plan.name),\n            .init(title: stringsProvider.planType, value: planTypeName)\n        ]'}], 'calls': [{'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 121, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.contractDate,\n                              value: date))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 126, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.linkedAccount,\n                              value: account))'}, {'target': 'PlanDetailInformation.Model', 'line': 130, 'evidence': 'PlanDetailInformation.Model(\n            header: .init(title: stringsProvider.planTypeSection),\n            rows: rows\n        )'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
private func map(plan: Plan, employeePlanDetail: EmployeePlanDetail?) -> PlanDetailInformation.Model {
        let planTypeName = planTypeName(employeePlanDetail?.planType ?? String(localized: stringsProvider.ppe))

        var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = [
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planName,
                  value: plan.name),
            .init(title: stringsProvider.planType, value: planTypeName)
        ]

        if let date = employeePlanDetail?.startDate {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.contractDate,
                              value: date))
        }

        if let account = employeePlanDetail?.linkedAccount {
            rows.append(.init(title: stringsProvider.linkedAccount,
                              value: account))
        }

        return PlanDetailInformation.Model(
            header: .init(title: stringsProvider.planTypeSection),
            rows: rows
        )
    }

SIGNATURE: private func map(plan: Plan, response: CompanyPlanDetailResponse) -> PlanDetailContentView.Model
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': ['private'], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [{'name': 'rows', 'type': 'PlanDetailRow', 'line': 140, 'evidence': 'var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()'}, {'name': 'rows', 'type': 'PlanDetailRow', 'line': 160, 'evidence': 'var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()'}], 'calls': [{'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 142, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,\n                    value: amount\n                ))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 148, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,\n                    value: taxDeduction\n                ))'}, {'target': 'items.append', 'line': 153, 'evidence': 'items.append(\n                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.companyContributionsTitle),\n                      rows: rows)\n            )'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 162, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,\n                    value: amount\n                ))'}, {'target': 'rows.append', 'line': 168, 'evidence': 'rows.append(.init(\n                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,\n                    value: taxDeduction\n                ))'}, {'target': 'items.append', 'line': 173, 'evidence': 'items.append(\n                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.yourContributionsTitle),\n                      rows: rows)\n            )'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
private func map(plan: Plan, response: CompanyPlanDetailResponse) -> PlanDetailContentView.Model {
        var items = [CompanyContributionsSection.Model.Item]()

        if let promoter = response.employeePlanDetail?.promoter {
            var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()
            if let amount = promoter.currentYearContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,
                    value: amount
                ))
            }
            if let taxDeduction = promoter.taxDeductionContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,
                    value: taxDeduction
                ))
            }
            items.append(
                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.companyContributionsTitle),
                      rows: rows)
            )
        }

        if let participant = response.employeePlanDetail?.participant {
            var rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model] = .init()
            if let amount = participant.voluntaryCurrentYearContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.companyContributionAmount,
                    value: amount
                ))
            }
            if let taxDeduction = participant.taxDeductionContribution {
                rows.append(.init(
                    title: stringsProvider.taxDeduction,
                    value: taxDeduction
                ))
            }
            items.append(
                .init(header: .init(title: stringsProvider.yourContributionsTitle),
                      rows: rows)
            )
        }

        return .init(header: map(plan: plan),
                     information: map(plan: plan, employeePlanDetail: response.employeePlanDetail),
                     contribution: .company(
                        model: .init(items: items)
                     ),
                     contributionsTab: stringsProvider.contributionsTab,
                     informationTab: stringsProvider.informationTab,
                     legal: stringsProvider.legal,
                     contribute: stringsProvider.contribute,
                     isContributionEnabled: false,
                     contributionReference: response.detailReference)
    }

SIGNATURE: private func planTypeName(_ type: String) -> String
METADATA: {'module': 'Plans', 'imports': ['import Foundation'], 'modifiers': ['private'], 'inherits_or_conforms': [], 'dependencies': [], 'calls': [{'target': 'type.lowercased', 'line': 193, 'evidence': 'type.lowercased()'}]}
------------------------------------------------------------
private func planTypeName(_ type: String) -> String {
        return switch type.lowercased() {
        case "ppad", "diferida": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaDiferida)
        case "ppa", "asegurada": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaAsegurada)
        case "rf", "fija": String(localized: stringsProvider.rentaFija)
        case "ppe", "empresa": String(localized: stringsProvider.ppe)
        default: type
        }
    }

package struct CompanyContributionsSection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package struct Item: Identifiable {
            package let id: UUID = UUID()
            package let header: PlanDetailSectionHeader.Model
            package let rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model]

            package init(header: PlanDetailSectionHeader.Model, rows: [PlanDetailRow.Model]) {
                self.header = header
                self.rows = rows
            }
        }
        package let items: [Item]

        package init(items: [Item]) {
            self.items = items
        }
    }

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(model.items) { item in
                PlanDetailSectionHeader(model: item.header)
                ForEach(item.rows) { row in
                    PlanDetailRow(model: row)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
    }
}

package struct PlanDetailHeader: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let balance: String
        package let capitalGain: String
        package let capitalGainColor: Color
        package let profitability: String
        package let lastValuationDate: String

        package init(
            balance: String,
            capitalGain: String,
            capitalGainColor: Color,
            profitability: String,
            lastValuationDate: String
        ) {
            self.balance = balance
            self.capitalGain = capitalGain
            self.capitalGainColor = capitalGainColor
            self.profitability = profitability
            self.lastValuationDate = lastValuationDate
        }
    }

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 4) {
            Text(model.balance)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())

            Text(model.capitalGain)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(model.capitalGainColor)

            Text(model.profitability)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            Text(model.lastValuationDate)
                .font(.caption2)
                .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(.vertical, 16)
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultPlanDetailFactory: PlanDetailFactory {
    typealias Params = PlanDetailFactoryParams

    let getPlanDetailUseCase: any GetPlanDetailUseCase
    let getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase
    let router: any PlanDetailRouter
    let stringsProvider: any PlanDetailStringsProvider
    let logger: any Logs

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> some View {
        let mapper = DefaultPlanDetailMapper(stringsProvider: stringsProvider)
        let viewModel = PlanDetailViewModel(planId: params.planId,
                                            getPlansUseCase: getPlansUseCase,
                                            getPlanDetailUseCase: getPlanDetailUseCase,
                                            mapper: mapper,
                                            stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                                            tracker: PlanDetailTracker(logger: logger))
        return PlanDetailView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.planDetailRouter, router)
    }

    func make(withParams params: Params) -> UIViewController {
        UIHostingController(rootView: make(withParams: params))
    }
}

struct PlanDetailView: View {
    @StateObject private var viewModel: PlanDetailViewModel

    init(viewModel: PlanDetailViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        PlanDetailContentView(
            state: $viewModel.state,
            selectedTab: $viewModel.selectedTab,
            onContributeTap: { label in viewModel.trackContributeTap(label: label) }
        )
        .navigationTitle(viewModel.navigationTitle)
        .task { await viewModel.load() }
        .onChange(of: viewModel.selectedTab) { newValue in
            viewModel.didSelectTab(newValue)
        }
    }
}

              .foregroundStyle(.secondary)'}]}

package struct PlanDetailContentView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package enum ContributionType {
            case personal(model: PersonalContributionsSection.Model)
            case company(model: CompanyContributionsSection.Model)
        }
        package let header: PlanDetailHeader.Model
        package let information: PlanDetailInformation.Model
        package let contribution: ContributionType
        package let contributionsTab: LocalizedStringResource
        package let informationTab: LocalizedStringResource
        package let legal: LocalizedStringResource
        package let contribute: LocalizedStringResource
        package let isContributionEnabled: Bool
        package let contributionReference: String?

        package init(header: PlanDetailHeader.Model,
                     information: PlanDetailInformation.Model,
                     contribution: ContributionType,
                     contributionsTab: LocalizedStringResource,
                     informationTab: LocalizedStringResource,
                     legal: LocalizedStringResource,
                     contribute: LocalizedStringResource,
                     isContributionEnabled: Bool,
                     contributionReference: String?) {
            self.header = header
            self.information = information
            self.contribution = contribution
            self.contributionsTab = contributionsTab
            self.informationTab = informationTab
            self.legal = legal
            self.contribute = contribute
            self.isContributionEnabled = isContributionEnabled
            self.contributionReference = contributionReference
        }
    }

    package init(state: Binding<ScreenState<Model, String>>,
                 selectedTab: Binding<Int>,
                 onContributeTap: @escaping (String) -> Void = { _ in }) {
        self._state = state
        self._selectedTab = selectedTab
        self.onContributeTap = onContributeTap
    }

    @Environment(\.planDetailRouter) private var router
    @Binding private var state: ScreenState<Model, String>
    @Binding private var selectedTab: Int
    private let onContributeTap: (String) -> Void

    package var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch state {
            case .initial:
                EmptyView()
            case .loading:
                ProgressView()
            case .error(let msg):
                Text(msg)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            case .success(let model):
                main(model: model)
            }
        }
    }

    func main(model: Model) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                    PlanDetailHeader(model: model.header)
                    tabPicker(model: model)
                    if selectedTab == 0 {
                        contributionsTab(type: model.contribution)
                    } else {
                        PlanDetailInformation(model: model.information)
                    }
                    legalSection(model: model)
                }
            }

            contributeButton(model: model)
        }
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
private extension PlanDetailContentView {
    // MARK: - Tab picker

    func tabPicker(model: Model) -> some View {
        Picker("", selection: $selectedTab) {
            Text(model.contributionsTab).tag(0)
            Text(model.informationTab).tag(1)
        }
        .pickerStyle(.segmented)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.bottom, 16)
    }

    // MARK: - Contributions Tab

    @ViewBuilder
    func contributionsTab(type: Model.ContributionType) -> some View {
        switch type {
        case .company(model: let model):
            CompanyContributionsSection(model: model)
        case .personal(model: let model):
            PersonalContributionsSection(model: model)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Legal

    func legalSection(model: Model) -> some View {
        Text(model.legal)
            .font(.footnote)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            .padding(16)
    }

    // MARK: - Contribute button (footer)

    @ViewBuilder func contributeButton(model: Model) -> some View {
        if !model.isContributionEnabled {
            EmptyView()
        } else {
            VStack {
                Divider()
                Button {
                    onContributeTap(model.contribute.spanish)
                    Task {
                        guard let ref = model.contributionReference else {
                            return
                        }
                        await router.startContribution(contributionReference: ref)
                    }
                } label: {
                    Text(model.contribute)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .padding(.vertical, 14)
                        .background(Color.green.opacity(0.4))
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.bottom, 8)
            }
        }
    }
}

@ViewBuilder func contributeButton(model: Model) -> some View {
        if !model.isContributionEnabled {
            EmptyView()
        } else {
            VStack {
                Divider()
                Button {
                    onContributeTap(model.contribute.spanish)
                    Task {
                        guard let ref = model.contributionReference else {
                            return
                        }
                        await router.startContribution(contributionReference: ref)
                    }
                } label: {
                    Text(model.contribute)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .padding(.vertical, 14)
                        .background(Color.green.opacity(0.4))
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.bottom, 8)
            }
        }
    }

class PlanDetailViewModel: ObservableObject {
    private let getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase
    private let getPlanDetailUseCase: any GetPlanDetailUseCase
    private let stringsProvider: any PlanDetailStringsProvider
    private let mapper: PlanDetailMapper
    private let tracker: any PlanDetailTracking
    private let planId: String
    private var typology: String = ""

    @Published var state: ScreenState<PlanDetailContentView.Model, String> = .initial
    @Published var selectedTab: Int = 0
    @Published var navigationTitle: String = .init()

    init(planId: String,
         getPlansUseCase: some GetPlansUseCase,
         getPlanDetailUseCase: some GetPlanDetailUseCase,
         mapper: some PlanDetailMapper,
         stringsProvider: some PlanDetailStringsProvider,
         tracker: some PlanDetailTracking) {
        self.planId = planId
        self.getPlansUseCase = getPlansUseCase
        self.getPlanDetailUseCase = getPlanDetailUseCase
        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
        self.mapper = mapper
        self.tracker = tracker
    }

    @MainActor func load() async {
        state = .loading

        guard let plan = try? await getPlansUseCase().first(
            where: { $0.id == planId }
        ) else {
            state = .error(model: String(localized: stringsProvider.errorDefaultMsg))
            return
        }

        guard let reference = plan.detailReference else {
            state = .error(model: String(localized: stringsProvider.errorDefaultMsg))
            return
        }

        navigationTitle = plan.name

        do {
            let result = try await getPlanDetailUseCase(
                reference: reference,
                type: plan.type
            )
            typology = typologyName(from: result)
            state = .success(model: mapper.map(plan: plan, result: result))
            tracker.trackContributionView(typology: typology)
        } catch {
            state = .error(model: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    @MainActor func didSelectTab(_ index: Int) {
        if index == 0 {
            tracker.trackContributionView(typology: typology)
        } else {
            tracker.trackInformationView(typology: typology)
        }
    }

    @MainActor func trackContributeTap(label: String) {
        if selectedTab == 0 {
            tracker.trackContributionClick(typology: typology, label: label)
        } else {
            tracker.trackInformationClick(typology: typology, label: label)
        }
    }

    private func typologyName(from result: PlanDetailResult) -> String {
        let rawType: String? = switch result {
        case .personal(let response): response.participantPlanDetail?.planType
        case .company(let response): response.employeePlanDetail?.planType
        }
        switch rawType?.lowercased() {
        case "ppad", "diferida": return stringsProvider.rentaDiferida.spanish
        case "ppa", "asegurada": return stringsProvider.rentaAsegurada.spanish
        case "rf", "fija": return stringsProvider.rentaFija.spanish
        case "ppe", "empresa": return stringsProvider.ppe.spanish
        default: return "-"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Domain model mapping

extension PlanDetail {
    func toPlan(index: Int, detailReference: String? = nil, detailQueryType: String? = nil) -> Plan {
        let resolvedType = Plan.PlanType(
            rawValue: detailQueryType ?? ""
        ) ?? (collectiveType == "E" ? .company : .personal)
        return Plan(
            id: "\(index)_\(modalityNumber ?? 0)",
            name: planDescription ?? "",
            type: resolvedType,
            balance: consolidatedRights ?? 0,
            capitalGain: capitalGain ?? 0,
            profitability: annualReturn ?? 0,
            consolidatedRights: consolidatedRights ?? 0,
            lastValuationDate: lastValuationDate ?? "",
            periodicContribution: plannedContribution,
            detailReference: detailReference,
            detailQueryType: detailQueryType,
            hasAlerts: hasAlerts,
            isConsultable: isConsultable == "S"
        )
    }
}

extension CompanyPlan {
    func toPlan(index: Int) -> Plan {
        let resolvedType = Plan.PlanType(rawValue: detailQueryType ?? "") ?? .personal
        return Plan(
            id: "fpe_\(index)_\(planData.modalityNumber ?? 0)",
            name: webDescription ?? planData.planDescription ?? "",
            type: resolvedType,
            balance: planData.consolidatedRights ?? 0,
            capitalGain: planData.capitalGain ?? 0,
            profitability: planData.annualReturn ?? 0,
            consolidatedRights: planData.consolidatedRights ?? 0,
            lastValuationDate: planData.lastValuationDate ?? "",
            periodicContribution: planData.plannedContribution,
            detailReference: detailReference,
            detailQueryType: detailQueryType,
            hasAlerts: planData.hasAlerts,
            isConsultable: planData.isConsultable == "S"
        )
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
extension Array where Element == Plan {
    var totalBalance: Double {
        reduce(0) { $0 + $1.balance }
    }

    var totalCapitalGain: Double {
        reduce(0) { $0 + $1.capitalGain }
    }

    var averageProfitability: Double {
        isEmpty ? 0 : reduce(0) {
            $0 + $1.profitability
        } / Double(count)
    }

    var totalContributions: Double {
        reduce(0) {
            $0 + $1.consolidatedRights
        }
    }
}

struct PlansOverviewTracker: PlansOverviewTracking {

    // MARK: - Constants

    private static let distributor = "distribuidora"
    private static let noPlan = "cliente sin plan"
    private static let errorService = "error servicio"
    private static let popUpdate = "popup informacion pendiente actualizar"
    private static let moduleEventPageName = "imaginbank:ahorro e inversion:mymoney:ahorrar"
    private static let moduleEventCategory = "ahorrar"

    private let logger: any Logs

    init(logger: any Logs) {
        self.logger = logger
    }

    // MARK: - Base Tags

    private func overviewBaseViewTags() -> [String: any Sendable] {
        var tags = PlansTealium.viewBaseTags()
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageCategory] = PlansTealium.save
        tags[AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory1] = PlansTealium.pensionPlans
        return tags
    }

    // MARK: - Track helpers

    private func trackView(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags = overviewBaseViewTags()
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackView(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    private func trackModuleEvent(_ name: String, extra: [String: any Sendable] = [:]) {
        var tags: [String: any Sendable] = [
            AnalyticsKeys.pageName: Self.moduleEventPageName,
            AnalyticsKeys.eventCategory: Self.moduleEventCategory
        ]
        extra.forEach { tags[$0.key] = $0.value }
        logger.trackEvent(name, category: PlansTealium.module, extraData: tags)
    }

    // MARK: - Views

    func trackDistributorView(typology: String) {
        trackView("plans_overview_distributor_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.distributor,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.distributor)",
                          AnalyticsKeys.processTypology: typology
                         ])
    }

    func trackNoPlanView() {
        trackView("plans_overview_no_plan_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.noPlan,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.noPlan)"
                         ])
    }

    func trackErrorView() {
        trackView("plans_overview_error_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.errorService,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.errorService)"
                         ])
    }

    func trackPopUpdateView() {
        trackView("plans_overview_popup_update_view",
                  extra: [AnalyticsKeys.pageSubcategory2: Self.popUpdate,
                          AnalyticsKeys.pageName: "\(PlansTealium.basePageName):\(Self.popUpdate)"
                         ])
    }

    // MARK: - Events

    func trackPrimaryButtonClick(label: String) {
        trackModuleEvent("plans_overview_primary_click",
                         extra: [AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + label,
                                 AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: label
                                ])
    }

    func trackDetailButtonClick(label: String) {
        trackModuleEvent("plans_overview_detail_click",
                         extra: [AnalyticsKeys.eventAction: AnalyticsValues.eventAction + label,
                                 AnalyticsKeys.eventLabel: label
                                ])
    }
}

struct DefaultPlansOverviewMapper: PlansOverviewMapper {
    private let plansStringsProvider: any PlansOverviewStringsProvider

    init(plansStringsProvider: any PlansOverviewStringsProvider) {
        self.plansStringsProvider = plansStringsProvider
    }

    func map(from sheet: InfoSheet) -> PlansInfoSheetView.Model {
        return switch sheet {
        case .balance:
                .init(title: plansStringsProvider.balanceHelperTitle,
                      body1: plansStringsProvider.balanceHelperBody1,
                      body2: plansStringsProvider.balanceHelperBody2)
        case .maxContribution:
                .init(title: plansStringsProvider.maxContributionTitle,
                      body1: plansStringsProvider.maxContributionBody)
        case .annualReturn:
                .init(title: plansStringsProvider.annualReturnTitle,
                      body1: plansStringsProvider.annualReturnBody)
        }
    }

    func map(error: Error) -> PlansErrorView.Model {
        .init(title: plansStringsProvider.errorTitle,
              subtitle: plansStringsProvider.errorSubtitle,
              actionTitle: plansStringsProvider.retry)
    }

    // TODO: currency harcoded to €? should get it from api?
    func map(from plans: [Plan]) -> PlansContentView.Model {
        let totalBalance = PlansUtils.amountString(
            amount: plans.totalBalance,
            currency: "EUR"
        )
        let totalCapitalGain = PlansUtils.signedAmount(
            amount: plans.totalCapitalGain,
            currency: "EUR"
        )
        let totalCapitalGainColor: Color = plans.totalCapitalGain >= 0 ? .primary : .red
        let averageProfitability = String(format: "%.2f%%", plans.averageProfitability)

        let header: PlansHeaderSection.Model = .init(totalBalance: totalBalance,
                                                     totalCapitalGain: totalCapitalGain,
                                                     totalCapitalGainColor: totalCapitalGainColor,
                                                     averageProfitability: averageProfitability)

        let maxAvailable = PlansUtils.amountString(amount: 0, currency: "EUR")
        let totalContributions = PlansUtils.amountString(
            amount: plans.totalContributions,
            currency: "EUR"
        )

        let model = PlansSummarySection.Model(summaryTitle: plansStringsProvider.summaryTitle,
                                              stillAportable: plansStringsProvider.stillAportable,
                                              maxAvailable: maxAvailable,
                                              initialContribution: plansStringsProvider.initialContribution,
                                              totalContributions: totalContributions,
                                              rentability: plansStringsProvider.rentability,
                                              averageProfitability: averageProfitability)

        let plans = PlansCardsSection.Model(
            myPlansTitle: plansStringsProvider.myPlansTitle,
            plans: plans.map({
                .init(id: $0.id,
                      name: $0.name,
                      capitalGain: PlansUtils.signedAmount(amount: $0.capitalGain, currency: "EUR"),
                      capitalGainForegroundStyle: $0.capitalGain >= 0 ? .primary : .red,
                      balance: PlansUtils.amountString(amount: $0.balance, currency: "EUR"),
                      profitability: String(format: "%.2f%%", $0.profitability),
                      isConsultable: $0.isConsultable)
            })
        )

        return .init(header: header,
                     plans: plans,
                     summary: model,
                     legal: plansStringsProvider.legal,
                     hire: plansStringsProvider.hire)
    }
}

        self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
    }

    // TODO: currency harcoded to EUR? should get it from api?
    func map(from plans: [Plan]) -> PlansModuleContentView.Model {
        let summary = SummarySection.Model(
            totalBalance: PlansUtils.amountString(
                amount: plans.totalBalance,
                currency: "EUR"
            ),
            totalCapitalGain: PlansUtils.signedAmount(
                amount: plans.totalCapitalGain,
                currency: "EUR"
            ),
            totalCapitalGainColor: plans.totalCapitalGain >= 0 ? .primary : .red,
            averageProfitability: String(format: "%.2f%%", plans.averageProfitability))

        let plans: PlansSection.Model = .init(
            plans: plans.map({
                .init(id: $0.id,
                      name: $0.name,
                      capitalGain: PlansUtils.signedAmount(amount: $0.capitalGain, currency: "EUR"),
                      capitalGainForegroundStyle: $0.capitalGain >= 0 ? .primary : .red,
                      balance: PlansUtils.amountString(amount: $0.balance, currency: "EUR"),
                      profitability: String(format: "%.2f%%", $0.profitability),
                      detailReference: $0.detailReference ?? "")
            })
        )

        return .init(title: stringsProvider.title,
                     buttonText: stringsProvider.buttonText,
                     primaryButtonText: stringsProvider.primaryButtonText,
                     summary: summary,
                     plans: plans)
    }

    func map(error: Error) -> PlansErrorView.Model {
        .init(title: stringsProvider.title,
              subtitle: stringsProvider.mymoneyError,
              actionTitle: nil)
    }
}

final class DefaultPlansOverviewCoordinator: PlansOverviewCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let plansOverviewFactory: any PlansOverviewFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         plansOverviewFactory: any PlansOverviewFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.plansOverviewFactory = plansOverviewFactory
    }

    func start(params: Void) async {
        let viewController: UIViewController = plansOverviewFactory.make()
        viewController.hidesBottomBarWhenPushed = true
        navigationController.pushViewController(viewController, animated: true)
    }
}

final class DefaultPlansOverviewRouter: PlansOverviewRouter {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController

    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: some InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func showPlanDetail(planId: String) async {
        let planDetailCoordinator = factory
            .makePlanDetailCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
        await planDetailCoordinator.start(params: .init(planId: planId))
    }

    func showHiringAdvantages() async {
        let hiringAdvantagesCoordinator = factory
            .makeHiringAdvantagesCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
        await hiringAdvantagesCoordinator.start()
    }
}

package struct PlansSection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package struct Plan: Identifiable {
            package let id: String
            package let name: String
            package let capitalGain: String
            package let capitalGainForegroundStyle: Color
            package let balance: String
            package let profitability: String
            package let detailReference: String

            package init(id: String,
                         name: String,
                         capitalGain: String,
                         capitalGainForegroundStyle: Color,
                         balance: String,
                         profitability: String,
                         detailReference: String) {
                self.id = id
                self.name = name
                self.capitalGain = capitalGain
                self.capitalGainForegroundStyle = capitalGainForegroundStyle
                self.balance = balance
                self.profitability = profitability
                self.detailReference = detailReference
            }
        }

        package let plans: [Plan]

        package init(plans: [Plan]) {
            self.plans = plans
        }
    }

    @Environment(\.plansWidgetRouter) private var router

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(model.plans) { plan in
                planCard(plan: plan)
            }
        }
    }

    private func planCard(plan: Model.Plan) -> some View {
        Button {
            Task {
                await router.startContribution(
                    contributionReference: plan.detailReference
                )
            }
        } label: {
            HStack {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(plan.name)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                    Text(plan.capitalGain)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(plan.capitalGainForegroundStyle)
                }
                Spacer()
                VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(plan.balance)
                        .font(.title3.bold())
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                    Text(plan.profitability)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            .padding(12)
            .background(Color(.secondarySystemBackground))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        }
    }
}

package struct SummarySection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let totalBalance: String
        package let totalCapitalGain: String
        package let totalCapitalGainColor: Color
        package let averageProfitability: String

        package init(totalBalance: String,
                     totalCapitalGain: String,
                     totalCapitalGainColor: Color,
                     averageProfitability: String) {
            self.totalBalance = totalBalance
            self.totalCapitalGain = totalCapitalGain
            self.totalCapitalGainColor = totalCapitalGainColor
            self.averageProfitability = averageProfitability
        }
    }

    package let model: Model

    package init(model: Model) {
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            Text(model.totalBalance)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())

            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text(model.totalCapitalGain)
                    .foregroundStyle(model.totalCapitalGainColor)
                Text(model.averageProfitability)
                    .foregroundStyle(.green)
            }
            .font(.subheadline)
        }
    }
}

@MainActor
enum PlansModuleAssembler {
    static func assemble(withParams params: Params) -> any View {
        let mapper = DefaultPlansWidgetMapper(stringsProvider: params.stringsProvider)

        let viewModel = PlansModuleViewModel(
            getPlansUseCase: params.getPlansUseCase,
            mapper: mapper
        )

        return PlansModuleView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.plansWidgetRouter, params.router)
            .environment(\.plansOverviewTracker, PlansOverviewTracker(logger: params.logger))
    }

    struct Params {
        let getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase
        let router: any PlansWidgetRouter
        let stringsProvider: any PlansComponentStringsProvider
        let logger: any Logs

        init(getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase,
             router: any PlansWidgetRouter,
             stringsProvider: any PlansComponentStringsProvider,
             logger: any Logs) {
            self.getPlansUseCase = getPlansUseCase
            self.router = router
            self.stringsProvider = stringsProvider
            self.logger = logger
        }
    }
}

struct PlansModuleView: View {
    struct Model {
        let summary: SummarySection.Model
        let plans: PlansSection.Model
    }

    @StateObject var viewModel: PlansModuleViewModel

    init(viewModel: PlansModuleViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.clear.task {
                await viewModel.load()
            }

            PlansModuleContentView(state: $viewModel.state)
        }
    }
}

package struct PlansModuleContentView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let title: LocalizedStringResource
        package let buttonText: LocalizedStringResource
        package let primaryButtonText: LocalizedStringResource
        package let summary: SummarySection.Model
        package let plans: PlansSection.Model

        package init(title: LocalizedStringResource,
                     buttonText: LocalizedStringResource,
                     primaryButtonText: LocalizedStringResource,
                     summary: SummarySection.Model,
                     plans: PlansSection.Model) {
            self.title = title
            self.buttonText = buttonText
            self.primaryButtonText = primaryButtonText
            self.summary = summary
            self.plans = plans
        }
    }

    @Environment(\.plansWidgetRouter) private var router
    @Environment(\.plansOverviewTracker) private var tracker

    @Binding private var state: ScreenState<Model, PlansErrorView.Model>

    package init(state: Binding<ScreenState<Model, PlansErrorView.Model>>) {
        self._state = state
    }

    package var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch state {
            case .success(model: let model):
                loadedView(model: model)
            case .error(let model):
                PlansErrorView(model: model, action: nil)
            case .loading:
                ProgressView()
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 120)
            case .initial:
                EmptyView()
            }
        }
    }
}

private extension PlansModuleContentView {
    func loadedView(model: Model) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            Text(model.title)
                .font(.title2.bold())

            SummarySection(model: model.summary)

            PlansSection(model: model.plans)

            buttonsRow(model: model)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(Color(.systemBackground))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
    }

    func buttonsRow(model: Model) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Button {
                tracker.trackDetailButtonClick(label: model.buttonText.spanish)
                Task {
                    await router.showDistributor()
                }
            } label: {
                Text(model.buttonText)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 12)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.bordered)

            Button {
                tracker.trackPrimaryButtonClick(label: model.primaryButtonText.spanish)
                Task {
                    await router.showHiringAdvantages()
                }
            } label: {
                Text(model.primaryButtonText)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 12)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
        }
    }
}

@MainActor
final class PlansModuleViewModel: ObservableObject {
    @Published var state: ScreenState<PlansModuleContentView.Model, PlansErrorView.Model> = .initial

    private let getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase
    private var currentPlans: [Plan] = []
    private let mapper: PlansWidgetMapper

    init(getPlansUseCase: some GetPlansUseCase,
         mapper: PlansWidgetMapper) {
        self.mapper = mapper
        self.getPlansUseCase = getPlansUseCase
    }

    func load() async {
        state = .loading
        do {
            let plans = try await getPlansUseCase()
            currentPlans = plans
            state = .success(model: mapper.map(from: plans))
        } catch {
            state = .error(model: mapper.map(error: error))
        }
    }
}

package struct PlansCardsSection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package struct Plan: Identifiable {
            package let id: String
            package let name: String
            package let capitalGain: String
            package let capitalGainForegroundStyle: Color
            package let balance: String
            package let profitability: String
            package let isConsultable: Bool

            package init(id: String,
                         name: String,
                         capitalGain: String,
                         capitalGainForegroundStyle: Color,
                         balance: String,
                         profitability: String,
                         isConsultable: Bool) {
                self.id = id
                self.name = name
                self.capitalGain = capitalGain
                self.capitalGainForegroundStyle = capitalGainForegroundStyle
                self.balance = balance
                self.profitability = profitability
                self.isConsultable = isConsultable
            }
        }

        package let myPlansTitle: LocalizedStringResource
        package let plans: [Plan]

        package init(myPlansTitle: LocalizedStringResource,
                     plans: [Plan]) {
            self.myPlansTitle = myPlansTitle
            self.plans = plans
        }
    }

    package let model: Model
    private let onPlanTap: (Model.Plan) -> Void

    package init(model: Model, onPlanTap: @escaping (Model.Plan) -> Void = { _ in }) {
        self.model = model
        self.onPlanTap = onPlanTap
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.medium) {
            Text(model.myPlansTitle)
                .font(.headline)
                .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)

            ForEach(model.plans) { plan in
                planCard(plan: plan)
                    .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
            }
        }
        .padding(.vertical, Spacing.standard)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
    }

    private func planCard(plan: Model.Plan) -> some View {
        Button {
            onPlanTap(plan)
        } label: {
            HStack {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.tight) {
                    Text(plan.name)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                    Text(plan.capitalGain)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(plan.capitalGainForegroundStyle)
                }

                Spacer()

                VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: Spacing.tight) {
                    Text(plan.balance)
                        .font(.title3.bold())
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                    Text(plan.profitability)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            .padding(Spacing.standard)
            .background(Color(.systemBackground))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CornerRadius.standard))
        }
    }
}

package struct PlansErrorView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let title: LocalizedStringResource
        package let subtitle: LocalizedStringResource
        package let actionTitle: LocalizedStringResource?

        package init(title: LocalizedStringResource,
                     subtitle: LocalizedStringResource,
                     actionTitle: LocalizedStringResource?) {
            self.title = title
            self.subtitle = subtitle
            self.actionTitle = actionTitle
        }
    }

    package let model: Model
    package let action: (() -> Void)?

    package init(model: Model,
                 action: (() -> Void)? = nil) {
        self.model = model
        self.action = action
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: Spacing.standard) {
            VStack(spacing: Spacing.tight) {
                Text(model.title)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

                Spacer().frame(height: Spacing.standard)

                Image("ic_warning", bundle: .module)
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFit()
                    .frame(height: 40)

                Text(model.subtitle)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }

            if let actionTitle = model.actionTitle {
                Button {
                    action?()
                } label: {
                    Text(actionTitle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}
