package struct PlansHeaderSection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let totalBalance: String
        package let totalCapitalGain: String
        package let totalCapitalGainColor: Color
        package let averageProfitability: String

        package init(totalBalance: String,
                     totalCapitalGain: String,
                     totalCapitalGainColor: Color,
                     averageProfitability: String) {
            self.totalBalance = totalBalance
            self.totalCapitalGain = totalCapitalGain
            self.totalCapitalGainColor = totalCapitalGainColor
            self.averageProfitability = averageProfitability
        }
    }

    @Binding var activeSheet: InfoSheet?

    package let model: Model

    package init(activeSheet: Binding<InfoSheet?>,
                 model: Model) {
        self._activeSheet = activeSheet
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.tight) {
            Text(model.totalBalance)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())

            HStack(spacing: Spacing.small) {
                Text(model.totalCapitalGain)
                    .foregroundStyle(model.totalCapitalGainColor)
                Text(model.averageProfitability)
                    .foregroundStyle(.green)

                Button {
                    activeSheet = .balance
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "info.circle")
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            .font(.subheadline)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
        .padding(.vertical, Spacing.medium)
    }
}

package struct PlansInfoSheetView: View {
    package struct Model: Equatable {
        package let title: LocalizedStringResource
        package let body1: LocalizedStringResource
        package var body2: LocalizedStringResource?

        package init(title: LocalizedStringResource,
                     body1: LocalizedStringResource,
                     body2: LocalizedStringResource? = nil) {
            self.title = title
            self.body1 = body1
            self.body2 = body2
        }
    }

    @Binding var activeSheet: InfoSheet?

    package let model: Model

    package init(activeSheet: Binding<InfoSheet?>,
                 model: Model) {
        self._activeSheet = activeSheet
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Spacing.standard) {
            HStack {
                Spacer()
                Button {
                    activeSheet = nil
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                        .font(.title3)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                }
            }

            Text(model.title)
                .font(.title2.bold())
            Text(model.body1)
                .font(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            if let body2 = model.body2 {
                Text(body2)
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(Spacing.large)
        .presentationDetents([.medium])
    }
}

package struct PlansSummarySection: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let summaryTitle: LocalizedStringResource
        package let stillAportable: LocalizedStringResource
        package let maxAvailable: String
        package let initialContribution: LocalizedStringResource
        package let totalContributions: String
        package let rentability: LocalizedStringResource
        package let averageProfitability: String

        package init(summaryTitle: LocalizedStringResource,
                     stillAportable: LocalizedStringResource,
                     maxAvailable: String,
                     initialContribution: LocalizedStringResource,
                     totalContributions: String,
                     rentability: LocalizedStringResource,
                     averageProfitability: String) {
            self.summaryTitle = summaryTitle
            self.stillAportable = stillAportable
            self.maxAvailable = maxAvailable
            self.initialContribution = initialContribution
            self.totalContributions = totalContributions
            self.rentability = rentability
            self.averageProfitability = averageProfitability
        }
    }

    @Binding var activeSheet: InfoSheet?

    package let model: Model

    package init(activeSheet: Binding<InfoSheet?>,
                 model: Model) {
        self._activeSheet = activeSheet
        self.model = model
    }

    package var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            Text(model.summaryTitle)
                .font(.title3.bold())
                .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
                .padding(.top, Spacing.large)
                .padding(.bottom, Spacing.standard)

            summaryRow(
                title: model.stillAportable,
                value: model.maxAvailable,
                infoSheet: .maxContribution
            )
            summaryRow(
                title: model.initialContribution,
                value: model.totalContributions
            )
            summaryRow(
                title: model.rentability,
                value: model.averageProfitability,
                infoSheet: .annualReturn
            )
        }
    }

    private func summaryRow(title: LocalizedStringResource,
                            value: String,
                            infoSheet: InfoSheet? = nil) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(title)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                    Text(value)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                Spacer()
                if let sheet = infoSheet {
                    Button {
                        activeSheet = sheet
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "info.circle")
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
            .padding(.vertical, Spacing.medium)

            Divider()
                .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
        }
    }
}

struct DefaultPlansOverviewFactory: PlansOverviewFactory {
    let getPlansUseCase: any GetPlansUseCase
    let router: any PlansOverviewRouter
    let plansStringsProvider: any PlansOverviewStringsProvider
    let logger: any Logs

    func make() -> some View {
        let mapper = DefaultPlansOverviewMapper(
            plansStringsProvider: plansStringsProvider
        )
        let viewModel = PlansViewModel(
            getPlansUseCase: getPlansUseCase,
            mapper: mapper,
            plansStringsProvider: plansStringsProvider,
            tracker: PlansOverviewTracker(logger: logger)
        )
        return PlansView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.plansOverviewRouter, router)
    }

    func make() -> UIViewController {
        UIHostingController(rootView: make())
    }
}

struct PlansView: View {
    struct Model {
        let header: PlansHeaderSection.Model
        let plans: PlansCardsSection.Model
        let summary: PlansSummarySection.Model
    }

    @StateObject private var viewModel: PlansViewModel

    init(viewModel: PlansViewModel) {
        _viewModel = StateObject(wrappedValue: viewModel)
    }

    var body: some View {
        PlansContentView(state: $viewModel.state,
                         activeSheet: $viewModel.activeSheet,
                         onReload: { Task { await viewModel.load() } },
                         onActiveSheet: { sheet in viewModel.infoSheetModel(sheet: sheet) },
                         onPlanTap: { planId in await viewModel.onPlanTapped(planId: planId) }
        )
        .navigationTitle(
            Text(viewModel.plansStringsProvider.myPlansTitle)
        )
        .task { await viewModel.load() }
        .alert(Text(viewModel.plansStringsProvider.notUpdatedTitle),
               isPresented: $viewModel.showNotConsultableAlert) {
            Button(role: .cancel) { } label: {
                Text(viewModel.plansStringsProvider.notUpdatedButton)
            }
        } message: {
            Text(viewModel.plansStringsProvider.notUpdatedMessage)
        }
    }
}

package struct PlansContentView: View {
    package struct Model {
        package let header: PlansHeaderSection.Model
        package let plans: PlansCardsSection.Model
        package let summary: PlansSummarySection.Model
        package let legal: LocalizedStringResource
        package let hire: LocalizedStringResource

        package init(header: PlansHeaderSection.Model,
                     plans: PlansCardsSection.Model,
                     summary: PlansSummarySection.Model,
                     legal: LocalizedStringResource,
                     hire: LocalizedStringResource) {
            self.header = header
            self.plans = plans
            self.summary = summary
            self.legal = legal
            self.hire = hire
        }
    }

    @Environment(\.plansOverviewRouter) private var router

    @Binding private var state: ScreenState<Model, PlansErrorView.Model>
    @Binding private var activeSheet: InfoSheet?

    private let onReload: () -> Void
    private let onActiveSheet: (InfoSheet) -> PlansInfoSheetView.Model
    private let onPlanTap: (String) async -> Bool

    package init(state: Binding<ScreenState<Model, PlansErrorView.Model>>,
                 activeSheet: Binding<InfoSheet?>,
                 onReload: @escaping () -> Void,
                 onActiveSheet: @escaping (InfoSheet) -> PlansInfoSheetView.Model,
                 onPlanTap: @escaping (String) async -> Bool = { _ in true }) {
        self._state = state
        self._activeSheet = activeSheet
        self.onReload = onReload
        self.onActiveSheet = onActiveSheet
        self.onPlanTap = onPlanTap
    }

    package var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch state {
            case .loading:
                ProgressView()
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            case .success(let model):
                loadedView(withModel: model)
            case .error(let model):
                PlansErrorView(model: model, action: onReload)
            case .initial:
                EmptyView()
            }
        }
    }
}

private extension PlansContentView {
    // MARK: - Loaded

    func loadedView(withModel model: Model) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                PlansHeaderSection(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                                   model: model.header)
                PlansCardsSection(model: model.plans) { plan in
                    Task {
                        if await onPlanTap(plan.id) {
                            await router.showPlanDetail(planId: plan.id)
                        }
                    }
                }
                PlansSummarySection(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                                    model: model.summary)
                legalSection(model: model)
                hireButton(model: model)
            }
        }.sheet(item: $activeSheet) { sheet in
            PlansInfoSheetView(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                               model: onActiveSheet(sheet))
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Legal

    func legalSection(model: Model) -> some View {
        Text(model.legal)
            .font(.footnote)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            .padding(Spacing.standard)
    }

    // MARK: - Hire button

    func hireButton(model: Model) -> some View {
        Button {
            Task { await router.showHiringAdvantages() }
        } label: {
            Text(model.hire)
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .padding(.vertical, 14)
                .background(Color.green.opacity(0.4))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CornerRadius.standard))
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, Spacing.standard)
        .padding(.bottom, Spacing.large)
    }
}

func loadedView(withModel model: Model) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                PlansHeaderSection(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                                   model: model.header)
                PlansCardsSection(model: model.plans) { plan in
                    Task {
                        if await onPlanTap(plan.id) {
                            await router.showPlanDetail(planId: plan.id)
                        }
                    }
                }
                PlansSummarySection(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                                    model: model.summary)
                legalSection(model: model)
                hireButton(model: model)
            }
        }.sheet(item: $activeSheet) { sheet in
            PlansInfoSheetView(activeSheet: $activeSheet,
                               model: onActiveSheet(sheet))
        }
    }

final class PlansViewModel: ObservableObject {
    let plansStringsProvider: any PlansOverviewStringsProvider

    @Published var state: ScreenState<PlansContentView.Model, PlansErrorView.Model> = .initial
    @Published var activeSheet: InfoSheet?
    @Published var showNotConsultableAlert: Bool = false

    private let getPlansUseCase: GetPlansUseCase
    private var currentPlans: [Plan] = []
    private let mapper: PlansOverviewMapper
    private let tracker: any PlansOverviewTracking

    init(getPlansUseCase: GetPlansUseCase,
         mapper: PlansOverviewMapper,
         plansStringsProvider: some PlansOverviewStringsProvider,
         tracker: some PlansOverviewTracking) {
        self.getPlansUseCase = getPlansUseCase
        self.plansStringsProvider = plansStringsProvider
        self.mapper = mapper
        self.tracker = tracker
    }

    @MainActor func load() async {
        state = .loading
        do {
            let plans = try await getPlansUseCase()
            currentPlans = plans
            state = .success(model: mapper.map(from: plans))

            if plans.isEmpty {
                tracker.trackNoPlanView()
            } else {
                let typology = PlansUtils.hasPendingTransfer(in: plans) ? "con traspaso" : "sin traspaso"
                tracker.trackDistributorView(typology: typology)
            }
        } catch {
            state = .error(model: mapper.map(error: error))
            tracker.trackErrorView()
        }
    }

    func infoSheetModel(sheet: InfoSheet) -> PlansInfoSheetView.Model {
        mapper.map(from: sheet)
    }

    @MainActor func onPlanTapped(planId: String) async -> Bool {
        guard let plan = currentPlans.first(where: { $0.id == planId }) else { return false }
        if plan.isConsultable {
            return true
        }
        tracker.trackPopUpdateView()
        showNotConsultableAlert = true
        return false
    }
}

final class DefaultPlansCoordinator: PlansCoordinator {
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController
    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         factory: some InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.factory = factory
    }

    func start(params: Void) async {
        let plansOverviewCoordinator = factory
            .makePlansOverviewCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
        await plansOverviewCoordinator.start()
    }
}

struct DefaultPlansFactory: PlansFactory {
    private var dependencies: PlansDependencies

    init(dependencies: PlansDependencies) {
        self.dependencies = dependencies
    }

    func makePlansCoordinator(navigation: UINavigationController) -> any PlansCoordinator {
        PlansCoordinatorAssembler.assembler(
            withParams: .init(navigationController: navigation,
                              factory: self)
        )
    }

    func makeEnjoyCoordinator(navigation: UINavigationController) -> any EnjoyCoordinator {
        let router = DefaultEnjoyRouter(navigationController: navigation, factory: self)
        return EnjoyCoordinatorAssembler.assemble(
            withParams: .init(navigationController: navigation,
                              router: router)
        )
    }

    func makePlansWidget(navigation: UINavigationController) -> any View {
        let stringsProvider = PlansComponentStringsProviderAssembler.assemble(
            withParams: .init(plansCommonStringsProvider: dependencies.plansCommonStringsProvider)
        )
        let router = DefaultPlansWidgetRouter(navigationController: navigation,
                                              factory: self)
        return PlansModuleAssembler.assemble(
            withParams: .init(getPlansUseCase: dependencies.getPlansUseCase,
                              router: router,
                              stringsProvider: stringsProvider,
                              logger: dependencies.logs)
        )
    }

    func makePlansEntryPoint(navigation: UINavigationController, router: any PlansRouter) -> AnyEntryPoint {
        let entryPoint = PlansEntryPoint(navigationController: navigation, router: router, factory: self)
        return AnyEntryPoint(entryPoint)
    }

    func makePlansDeepLinkInitializer() -> any DeepLinkInitializer {
        PlansDeepLinkInitializer()
    }
}

    func makePlansOverviewCoordinator(
        navigation: UINavigationController

------------------------------------------------------------
actor PlansCacheDataSource {
    private var plans: [Plan]?
    private var needsReload: Bool = true

    init() {}

    func cachedPlans() -> [Plan]? {
        guard !needsReload else { return nil }
        return plans
    }

    func store(_ plans: [Plan]) {
        self.plans = plans
        self.needsReload = false
    }

    func invalidate() {
        needsReload = true
    }
}

struct DefaultPlansRemoteDataSource: PlansRemoteDataSource {
    private let api: DataTransferService

    init(api: DataTransferService) {
        self.api = api
    }

    // MARK: - My Plans

    func fetchPlans() async throws(NetworkingError) -> [Plan] {
        let body = MyPlansRequest(
            callOption: MyPlansRequest.Constants.callOptionFPE,
            returnCancelledFPE: MyPlansRequest.Constants.returnCancelledNo
        )
        let endpoint: Endpoint<MyPlansResponse> = PlansEndpoint.myPlans.endpoint(body: body)
        let response = try await api.request(with: endpoint)
        return PlansResponseMapper.map(response)
    }

    // MARK: - Plan Detail

    func fetchPersonalPlanDetail(reference: String) async throws(NetworkingError) -> PersonalPlanDetailResponse {
        let body = PersonalPlanDetailRequest(detailReference: reference)
        let endpoint: Endpoint<PersonalPlanDetailResponse> = PlansEndpoint.personalPlanDetail.endpoint(body: body)
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    func fetchCompanyPlanDetail(reference: String) async throws(NetworkingError) -> CompanyPlanDetailResponse {
        let body = CompanyPlanDetailRequest(detailReference: reference)
        let endpoint: Endpoint<CompanyPlanDetailResponse> = PlansEndpoint.companyPlanDetail.endpoint(body: body)
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    // MARK: - Contribution

    func fetchContributionData(reference: String) async throws(NetworkingError) -> ContributionDataResponse {
        let body = ContributionDataRequest(detailReference: reference)
        let endpoint: Endpoint<ContributionDataResponse> = PlansEndpoint.contributionData.endpoint(body: body)
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    func fetchPromotions() async throws(NetworkingError) -> PromotionsResponse {
        let endpoint: Endpoint<PromotionsResponse> = PlansEndpoint.promotions.endpoint()
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    func simulateContribution(
        request: ContributionSimulationRequest
    ) async throws(NetworkingError) -> ContributionSimulationResponse {
        let endpoint: Endpoint<ContributionSimulationResponse> = PlansEndpoint.contributionSimulation.endpoint(
            body: request
        )
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    // MARK: - Authorization

    func startContributionAuth(
        request: ContributionAuthStartRequest
    ) async throws(NetworkingError) {
        let endpoint = PlansEndpoint.contributionAuthStart.endpointVoid(body: request)
        try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }

    func getContributionAuthResult(
        request: ContributionAuthStartRequest
    ) async throws(NetworkingError) -> ContributionAuthResultResponse {
        let endpoint: Endpoint<ContributionAuthResultResponse> = PlansEndpoint.contributionAuthResult.endpoint(
            body: request
        )
        return try await api.request(with: endpoint)
    }
}

enum PlansResponseMapper {
    static func map(_ response: MyPlansResponse) -> [Plan] {
        guard let allPlans = response.companyPlansList else { return [] }

        return allPlans
            .enumerated()
            .map { $1.toPlan(index: $0) }
            .sorted { $0.consolidatedRights > $1.consolidatedRights }
    }
}

enum PlansEndpoint {
    case myPlans
    case personalPlanDetail
    case companyPlanDetail
    case contributionData
    case promotions
    case contributionSimulation
    case contributionAuthStart
    case contributionAuthResult

    var path: String {
        switch self {
        case .myPlans:                  return "pld/misPlanes"
        case .personalPlanDetail:       return "cpp/detallePlanParticipe"
        case .companyPlanDetail:        return "ple/detallePlanParticipe"
        case .contributionData:         return "planesAbsis/datosAportacionPlan"
        case .promotions:               return "planesAbsis/aportacionListadoPromociones"
        case .contributionSimulation:   return "planesAbsis/aportacionSimulacion"
        case .contributionAuthStart:    return "planesAbsis/aportacion/autorizacion/inicio"
        case .contributionAuthResult:   return "planesAbsis/aportacion/autorizacion/resultado"
        }
    }

    var method: HTTPMethodType {
        return switch self {
        case .promotions: .get
        default: .post
        }
    }

    var baseUrl: NetworkBaseUrl {
        .xmlApps
    }

    var contentType: ContentType {
        .defaultJSONHeaders
    }

    var bodyEncoding: BodyEncoding {
        .jsonSerializationData
    }

    func endpoint<T: Decodable>(body: Encodable? = nil) -> Endpoint<T> {
        Endpoint<T>(
            path: path,
            method: method,
            bodyParametersEncodable: body,
            bodyEncoding: bodyEncoding,
            networkBaseUrl: baseUrl,
            contentType: contentType
        )
    }

    func endpointVoid(body: Encodable? = nil) -> Endpoint<Void> {
        Endpoint<Void>(
            path: path,
            method: method,
            bodyParametersEncodable: body,
            bodyEncoding: bodyEncoding,
            networkBaseUrl: baseUrl,
            contentType: contentType
        )
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
struct DefaultPlansRepository: PlansRepository {
    private let remote: any PlansRemoteDataSource
    private let cache: PlansCacheDataSource

    init(remote: any PlansRemoteDataSource,
         cache: PlansCacheDataSource) {
        self.remote = remote
        self.cache = cache
    }

    func getPlans() async throws -> [Plan] {
        if let cached = await cache.cachedPlans() { return cached }
        let plans = try await remote.fetchPlans()
        await cache.store(plans)
        return plans
    }

    func invalidateCache() async {
        await cache.invalidate()
    }
}

public struct PlansDeepLinkMatcher: DeepLinkMatcher {

    private let consultaTemplate = DeepLinkPathTemplate("planes/consulta")
    private let contratacionTemplate = DeepLinkPathTemplate("planes/contratacion")

    public init() {}

    public func match(uri: String) -> DeepLinkMatch? {
        let (path, _) = uri.splitPathAndQuery()

        if consultaTemplate.match(path: path) != nil {
            return DeepLinkMatch(screen: PlansScreen.overview, requiresAuth: true)
        }

        if contratacionTemplate.match(path: path) != nil {
            return DeepLinkMatch(screen: PlansScreen.hiringAdvantages, requiresAuth: true)
        }

        return nil
    }
}

public final class PlansEntryPoint: EntryPoint {
    private let factory: any InternalPlansFactory
    private let router: any PlansRouter
    private unowned let navigationController: UINavigationController

    init(navigationController: UINavigationController,
         router: any PlansRouter,
         factory: any InternalPlansFactory) {
        self.navigationController = navigationController
        self.router = router
        self.factory = factory
    }

    @MainActor
    public func start(screen: PlansScreen) async {
        await router.navigateToPlansTab()

        switch screen {
        case .overview:
            let coordinator = factory.makePlansOverviewCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
            await coordinator.start()
        case .hiringAdvantages:
            let coordinator = factory.makeHiringAdvantagesCoordinator(navigation: navigationController)
            await coordinator.start()
        }
    }
}

enum PlansUtils {
    // MARK: - Currency

    static func signedAmount(amount: Double, currency: String?) -> String {
        let formatted = amountString(amount: abs(amount), currency: currency)
        if amount > 0 { return "+\(formatted)" }
        if amount < 0 { return "-\(formatted)" }
        return formatted
    }

    static func amountString(amount: Double, currency: String?) -> String {
        amountString(amount: amount, minDecimals: 2, maxDecimals: 2, currency: currency)
    }

    static func amountString(amount: Double, minDecimals: Int?, maxDecimals: Int?, currency: String?) -> String {
        let min = minDecimals ?? 0
        let max = maxDecimals ?? 0
        let formatted = amount.formatted(
            .number
                .locale(Locale(identifier: "es_ES"))
                .grouping(.automatic)
                .precision(.fractionLength(min...max))
        )
        let space = (currency == "%" || currency == "") ? "" : " "
        return "\(formatted)\(space)\(currencySymbol(currency ?? ""))"
    }

    static func currencySymbol(_ currency: String) -> String {
        switch currency {
        case "EUR": return "€"
        case "USD": return "$"
        case "GBP": return "£"
        case "JPY", "CNY": return "¥"
        case "TRY": return "₺"
        case "HKD": return "HK$"
        default: return currency
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Plans

    /// Returns whether any plan in the list has a pending transfer (internal or external),
    /// based on the legacy `indAvisos` string: position 1 == "S" (internal) or position 5 == "E" (external).
    static func hasPendingTransfer(in plans: [Plan]) -> Bool {
        plans.contains { plan in
            guard let alerts = plan.hasAlerts else { return false }
            let chars = Array(alerts)
            let internalTransfer = chars.count > 1 && chars[1] == "S"
            let externalTransfer = chars.count > 5 && chars[5] == "E"
            return internalTransfer || externalTransfer
        }
    }

    // MARK: - String parsing

    static func stringWithCommaToDouble(_ stringValue: String) -> Double {
        let strategy = FloatingPointFormatStyle<Double>(locale: Locale(identifier: "es_ES"))
            .grouping(.automatic)
            .parseStrategy
        return (try? strategy.parse(stringValue)) ?? 0
    }
}

------------------------------------------------------------
static func signedAmount(amount: Double, currency: String?) -> String {
        let formatted = amountString(amount: abs(amount), currency: currency)
        if amount > 0 { return "+\(formatted)" }
        if amount < 0 { return "-\(formatted)" }
        return formatted
    }
